                  {/* Post Title and Content */}
                  &lt;div&gt;
                    &lt;h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white mb-2 leading-tight"&gt;
                      {selectedPost.title}
                    &lt;/h2&gt;
                    &lt;p className="text-gray-700 dark:text-slate-300 leading-relaxed"&gt;
                      {selectedPost.content}
                    &lt;/p&gt;
                  &lt;/div&gt;
&nbsp;
                  {/* Poll Display */}
                  {selectedPost.postType === 'poll' &amp;&amp; selectedPost.pollOptions &amp;&amp; (
                    &lt;div className="p-4 bg-gray-100/50 dark:bg-slate-800/30 rounded-xl"&gt;
                      &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3"&gt;
                        &lt;BarChart3 className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-400" /&gt;
                        &lt;span className="text-sm font-medium text-purple-400"&gt;Poll&lt;/span&gt;
                      &lt;/div&gt;
                      &lt;div className="space-y-2"&gt;
                        {selectedPost.pollOptions.map(<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >(o</span>ption, index) =&gt; {
                          const votes = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >selectedPost.pollVotes || {};</span>
                          const optionVotes = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >votes[index] || 0;</span>
                          const totalVotes = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >selectedPost.pollOptions!.reduce(<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >(s</span>um, _, optionIndex) =&gt; {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >                            return sum + (votes[optionIndex] || 0);</span>
                          }, 0);
                          const percentage = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >totalVotes &gt; 0 ? Math.round((optionVotes / totalVotes) * 100) : 0;</span>
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >                          return (</span>
                            &lt;div key={index} className="flex items-center justify-between p-2 bg-white/50 dark:bg-slate-700/30 rounded-lg"&gt;
                              &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-2"&gt;
                                &lt;span className="text-xs font-medium bg-gray-200 dark:bg-slate-600 w-5 h-5 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center"&gt;
                                  {String.fromCharCode(65 + index)}
                                &lt;/span&gt;
                                &lt;span className="text-sm"&gt;{option}&lt;/span&gt;
                              &lt;/div&gt;
                              &lt;div className="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-slate-400"&gt;
                                {percentage}% ({optionVotes})
                              &lt;/div&gt;
                            &lt;/div&gt;
                          );
                        })}
                      &lt;/div&gt;
                    &lt;/div&gt;
                  )}
&nbsp;
                  {/* Additional Images */}
                  {selectedPost.images &amp;&amp; selectedPost.images.length &gt; 1 &amp;&amp; (
                    &lt;div&gt;
                      &lt;h4 className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-2"&gt;
                        All Images ({selectedPost.images.length})
                      &lt;/h4&gt;
                      &lt;div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2"&gt;
                        {selectedPost.images.slice(1).map(<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >(i</span>mage, index) =&gt; (
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >                          &lt;div key={index + 1} c</span>lassName="aspect-square rounded-lg overflow-hidden bg-gray-100 dark:bg-slate-800"&gt;
                            &lt;img
                              src={image}
                              alt={`Post image ${index + 2}`}
                              className="w-full h-full object-cover hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-200 cursor-pointer"
                              onClick={<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >() =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >w</span>indow.open(image, '_blank')}</span>
                            /&gt;
                          &lt;/div&gt;
                        ))}
                      &lt;/div&gt;
                    &lt;/div&gt;
                  )}
                &lt;/div&gt;
              &lt;/div&gt;
&nbsp;
              {/* Footer - Stats and Actions */}
              &lt;div className="p-4 border-t border-gray-200 dark:border-slate-700"&gt;
                {/* Stats */}
                &lt;div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-slate-500 mb-3"&gt;
                  &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-4"&gt;
                    {<span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >selectedPost.likeCount &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; (</span>
                      &lt;span className="flex items-center gap-1"&gt;
                        &lt;Heart className="w-4 h-4 fill-red-500 text-red-500" /&gt;
                        &lt;span className="text-red-400 font-medium"&gt;{selectedPost.likeCount}&lt;/span&gt;
                      &lt;/span&gt;
                    )}
                    {<span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >selectedPost.commentCount &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; (</span>
                      &lt;span className="flex items-center gap-1"&gt;
                        &lt;MessageCircle className="w-4 h-4" /&gt;
                        &lt;span&gt;{selectedPost.commentCount} comments&lt;/span&gt;
                      &lt;/span&gt;
                    )}
                  &lt;/div&gt;
                &lt;/div&gt;
&nbsp;
                {/* Action Buttons */}
                &lt;div className="flex items-center justify-between"&gt;
                  &lt;button
                    onClick={<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >() =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >r</span>outer.push(`/community?post=${selectedPost.threadId}`)}</span>
                    className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium text-blue-400 hover:text-blue-300 hover:bg-blue-500/10 transition-all duration-300"
                  &gt;
                    &lt;MessageCircle className="w-4 h-4" /&gt;
                    &lt;span&gt;Join Discussion&lt;/span&gt;
                  &lt;/button&gt;
&nbsp;
                  &lt;button
                    onClick={<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >() =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >h</span>andleUnsavePost(selectedPost.threadId)}</span>
                    className="p-2 text-amber-500 hover:text-amber-400 hover:bg-amber-500/10 rounded-lg transition-all duration-300"
                    title="Remove from saved"
                  &gt;
                    &lt;Bookmark className="w-4 h-4 fill-current" /&gt;
                  &lt;/button&gt;
                &lt;/div&gt;
              &lt;/div&gt;
            &lt;/div&gt;
          &lt;/div&gt;
        &lt;/div&gt;
      )}

  );

        &lt;/div&gt;

  );

// Helper function to calculate time ago
function <span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >getTimeAgo(d</span>ate: Date | string): string {
  const now = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >new Date();</span>
&nbsp;
  // Handle string input from database
  let targetDate: Date;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  if (typeof date === 'string') {</span>
    // If the date string doesn't end with 'Z', treat it as local time
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (!date.endsWith('Z') &amp;&amp; !date.includes('+')) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      targetDate = new Date(date + 'Z'); /</span>/ Treat as UTC
    } else {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      targetDate = new Date(date);</span>
    }
  } else {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    targetDate = date;</span>
  }
&nbsp;
  // Ensure we have valid dates
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (!(targetDate instanceof Date) || isNaN(targetDate.getTime())) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return 'Just now';</span>
  }
&nbsp;
  // Simple direct comparison without timezone conversion
  const diffInMs = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >now.getTime() - targetDate.getTime();</span>
  const diffInSeconds = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >Math.floor(diffInMs / 1000);</span>
&nbsp;
  // Handle future dates (in case of timezone issues)
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (diffInSeconds &lt; 0) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return 'Just now';</span>
  }
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  if (diffInSeconds &lt; 60) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return 'Just now';</span>
  } else <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >if (diffInSeconds &lt; 3600) {</span>
    const minutes = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >Math.floor(diffInSeconds / 60);</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return `${minutes}m ago`;</span>
  } else <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >if (diffInSeconds &lt; 86400) {</span>
    const hours = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >Math.floor(diffInSeconds / 3600);</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return `${hours}h ago`;</span>
  } else <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >if (diffInSeconds &lt; 604800) { // 7 days</span>
    const days = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >Math.floor(diffInSeconds / 86400);</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return `${days}d ago`;</span>
  } else <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >if (diffInSeconds &lt; 2592000) { // 30 days</span>
    const weeks = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >Math.floor(diffInSeconds / 604800);</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return `${weeks}w ago`;</span>
  } else <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >if (diffInSeconds &lt; 31536000) { // 365 days</span>
    const months = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >Math.floor(diffInSeconds / 2592000);</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return `${months}mo ago`;</span>
  } else {
    const years = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >Math.floor(diffInSeconds / 31536000);</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return `${years}y ago`;</span>
  }
} </pre></td></tr></table></pre>

// GET /api/community/threads-drizzle - Fetch threads using Drizzle ORM
export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
    const page = parseInt(searchParams.get('page') || '1');
    const limit = parseInt(searchParams.get('limit') || '10');
    const sortBy = (searchParams.get('sortBy') || 'recent') as 'recent' | 'popular' | 'mostComments';
    const search = searchParams.get('search') || undefined;
&nbsp;
    if (isNaN(page) || isNaN(limit) || page &lt; 1 || limit &lt; 1) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error: 'Invalid pagination parameters',
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }
&nbsp;
    const offset = (page - 1) * limit;
&nbsp;
    // Fetch threads using Drizzle helper
    const [threads, totalCount] = await Promise.all([
      getThreads({ limit, offset, sortBy, search }),
      getThreadCount(search)
    ]);
&nbsp;
    console.log(`✅ Fetched ${threads.length} threads using Drizzle ORM`);
&nbsp;
    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      data: {
        threads,
        pagination: {
          page,
          limit,
          total: totalCount,
          totalPages: Math.ceil(totalCount / limit),
        },
      },
    });
&nbsp;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('❌ Drizzle API Error:', error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error: 'Failed to fetch threads',
        details: error instanceof Error ? error.message : <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >'Unknown error'</span>
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}
&nbsp;
// POST /api/community/threads-drizzle - Create new thread using Drizzle ORM
export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const { userId } = await auth();
&nbsp;
    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (!userId) {

&nbsp;

&nbsp;

    const newThread = await createThread({

      body,
      createdBy: user.userId,
      subjectId,
      topicId,
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      data: newThread,

  } catch (error) {

export async function <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >GET(r</span></span>equest: NextRequest) {

    const { searchParams } = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >new URL(request.url);</span>

    const users = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await db</span>
      .select({

      grade: user.grade || '',
      school: user.school || '',
      country: user.country || '',

// We'll treat all files as inputs to the Qwen model instead of trying to parse PDFs ourselves
&nbsp;
// Enhanced interface for complex message content types
interface MessageContent {
  type: string;
  text?: string;
  image_url?: {
    url: string;
  };
}
&nbsp;
// Message type for the API
interface ChatMessage {
  role: string;
  content: string | MessageContent[];
}
&nbsp;
// POST /api/doubt-solving
// Expects a JSON body: { messages: { role: "user" | "assistant" | "system", content: string }[] }
// Returns: { reply: string }
//
// The route forwards the chat conversation to the OpenRouter API using the free Qwen2.5 VL 32B Instruct model and
// returns the assistant's reply.
//
// It requires an environment variable `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` to be set in the Vercel / Next.js runtime.
&nbsp;
interface UploadedFile {
  name: string;
  type: string;
  data: string; // base64 encoded (no data: prefix)
}
&nbsp;

        { status: 400 }

        role: "system",
        content: `You are Qwen2.5 VL, an advanced AI assistant specializing in educational support and problem-solving.
&nbsp;
Use your enhanced reasoning capabilities to:
1. Provide detailed, step-by-step explanations for academic questions
2. Show all mathematical reasoning clearly with proper LaTeX formatting using $ for inline and $$ for display equations
3. Structure your responses with clear formatting using Markdown (bold headings, numbered lists, etc.)
4. For coding questions, provide well-commented code with explanations
5. When appropriate, offer multiple solution approaches to deepen understanding
6. Always provide complete responses - never cut off explanations mid-sentence
7. If a problem has multiple parts, address each part thoroughly
8. Include final answers and conclusions clearly
&nbsp;
Always aim for educational value that helps the student learn the underlying concepts, not just the answer. Ensure your response is complete and comprehensive.`
      });

// GET - Fetch user's doubt-solving sessions
export async function <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >GET(</span></span>request: NextRequest) {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  try {</span>
    const { userId } = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await auth();</span>
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (!userId) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return NextResponse.json(</span>
        { error: 'Unauthorized - Please log in to view sessions' },
        { status: 401 }
      );
    }
&nbsp;
    // Ensure user exists in database
    const syncResult = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await syncUserToDatabase();</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (!syncResult.success) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      console.warn('User sync failed:', syncResult.message);</span>
    }
&nbsp;
    // Get user's database ID using correct column names
    const userResult = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await db.execute(sql`</span>
      SELECT "user_id" FROM users WHERE "clerk_id" = ${userId} LIMIT 1
    `);
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (!userResult.rows || userResult.rows.length === 0) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return NextResponse.json(</span>
        { error: 'User not found in database' },
        { status: 404 }
      );
    }
&nbsp;
    const userDbId = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >userResult.rows[0].user_id;</span>
&nbsp;
    // Fetch sessions with message count

        s.session_id,

        s.subject_id,
        s.topic_id,
        s.message_count,
        s.last_message_at,
        s.is_archived,
        s.created_at,
        s.updated_at,

      FROM doubt_solving_sessions s
      LEFT JOIN doubt_solving_messages m ON s.session_id = m.session_id
      WHERE s.user_id = ${userDbId}
      GROUP BY s.session_id, s.title, s.subject_id, s.topic_id, s.message_count, s.last_message_at, s.is_archived, s.created_at, s.updated_at

    `);

// GET - Fetch specific session details
export async function <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >GET(</span></span>
  request: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise&lt;{ sessionId: string }&gt; }
) {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  try {</span>
    const { userId } = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await auth();</span>
    const { sessionId } = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await params;</span>
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (!userId) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return NextResponse.json(</span>
        { error: 'Unauthorized - Please log in to view session' },
        { status: 401 }
      );
    }
&nbsp;
    // Ensure user exists in database
    const syncResult = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await syncUserToDatabase();</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (!syncResult.success) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      console.warn('User sync failed:', syncResult.message);</span>
    }
&nbsp;
    // Get user's database ID using correct column names
    const userResult = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await db.execute(sql`</span>
      SELECT "user_id" FROM users WHERE "clerk_id" = ${userId} LIMIT 1
    `);
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (!userResult.rows || userResult.rows.length === 0) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return NextResponse.json(</span>
        { error: 'User not found in database' },
        { status: 404 }
      );
    }
&nbsp;
    const userDbId = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >userResult.rows[0].user_id;</span>
&nbsp;
    // Fetch session details
    const sessionResult = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await db.execute(sql`</span>
      SELECT 
        s.session_id,
        s.title,
        s.subject_id,
        s.topic_id,
        s.message_count,
        s.last_message_at,
        s.is_archived,
        s.created_at,
        s.updated_at,
        COUNT(m.message_id) as actual_message_count
      FROM doubt_solving_sessions s
      LEFT JOIN doubt_solving_messages m ON s.session_id = m.session_id
      WHERE s.session_id = ${sessionId} AND s.user_id = ${userDbId}
      GROUP BY s.session_id, s.title, s.subject_id, s.topic_id, s.message_count, s.last_message_at, s.is_archived, s.created_at, s.updated_at
    `);
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (!sessionResult.rows || sessionResult.rows.length === 0) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return NextResponse.json(</span>
        { error: 'Session not found or access denied' },
        { status: 404 }
      );
    }
&nbsp;
    const session = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >sessionResult.rows[0];</span>
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return NextResponse.json({</span>
      session: {
        id: session.session_id,
        title: session.title,
        subjectId: session.subject_id,
        topicId: session.topic_id,
        messageCount: session.actual_message_count || 0,
        lastMessageDate: new Date(session.last_message_at),
        isArchived: session.is_archived,
        createdAt: session.created_at,
        updatedAt: session.updated_at,
      }
    });
&nbsp;
  } catch (error) {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    console.error('Error fetching doubt-solving session:', error);</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return NextResponse.json(</span>
      { error: 'Failed to fetch session' },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

<span class="cline-any cline-neutral">&nbsp;</span></td><td class="text"><pre class="prettyprint lang-js">import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >'next/server';</span>
import { db } from <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >'@/db';</span>
import { doubtSolvingSessionsTable, doubtSolvingMessagesTable } from '@/db/schema';
import { sql } from <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >'drizzle-orm';</span>
import { auth } from <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >'@clerk/nextjs/server';</span>
import { syncUserToDatabase } from <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >'@/lib/user-sync';</span>
&nbsp;
// GET - Fetch messages for a specific session
export async function <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >GET(</span></span>
  request: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise&lt;{ sessionId: string }&gt; }
) {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  try {</span>
    const { userId } = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await auth();</span>
    const { sessionId } = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await params;</span>
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (!userId) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return NextResponse.json(</span>
        { error: 'Unauthorized - Please log in to view messages' },
        { status: 401 }
      );
    }
&nbsp;
    // Ensure user exists in database
    const syncResult = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await syncUserToDatabase();</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (!syncResult.success) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      console.warn('User sync failed:', syncResult.message);</span>
    }
&nbsp;
    // Get user's database ID using correct column names
    const userResult = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await db.execute(sql`</span>
      SELECT "user_id" FROM users WHERE "clerk_id" = ${userId} LIMIT 1
    `);
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (!userResult.rows || userResult.rows.length === 0) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return NextResponse.json(</span>
        { error: 'User not found in database' },
        { status: 404 }
      );
    }
&nbsp;
    const userDbId = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >userResult.rows[0].user_id;</span>
&nbsp;
    // Verify session belongs to user
    const sessionResult = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await db.execute(sql`</span>
      SELECT session_id FROM doubt_solving_sessions 
      WHERE session_id = ${sessionId} AND user_id = ${userDbId}
      LIMIT 1
    `);
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (!sessionResult.rows || sessionResult.rows.length === 0) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return NextResponse.json(</span>
        { error: 'Session not found or access denied' },
        { status: 404 }
      );
    }
&nbsp;
    // Fetch messages for the session
    const messagesResult = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await db.execute(sql`</span>
      SELECT 
        message_id,
        role,
        content,
        attachment_url,
        attachment_type,
        attachment_name,
        token_count,
        processing_time,
        model_used,
        metadata,
        created_at
      FROM doubt_solving_messages
      WHERE session_id = ${sessionId}
      ORDER BY created_at ASC
    `);
&nbsp;
    const messages = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >messagesResult.rows.map(<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >(m</span>essage: any) =&gt; (<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >{</span></span>
      id: message.message_id,
      role: message.role,
      content: message.content,
      attachmentUrl: message.attachment_url,
      attachmentType: message.attachment_type,
      attachmentName: message.attachment_name,
      tokenCount: message.token_count,
      processingTime: message.processing_time,
      modelUsed: message.model_used,
      metadata: message.metadata,
      timestamp: new Date(message.created_at),
    }));
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return NextResponse.json({ messages });</span>

      &lt;div className="p-4 bg-green-50 dark:bg-green-900/20 border border-green-200 dark:border-green-800/30 text-green-800 dark:text-green-300 rounded-lg flex items-start mb-6"&gt;
        &lt;Check className="w-5 h-5 mr-2 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0" /&gt;
        &lt;div&gt;
          &lt;p className="text-sm font-medium"&gt;Recovery code sent&lt;/p&gt;
          &lt;p className="text-sm"&gt;We've sent a code to {email}&lt;/p&gt;
        &lt;/div&gt;
      &lt;/div&gt;
&nbsp;
      &lt;div&gt;
        &lt;label htmlFor="code" className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-200 mb-1"&gt;
          Recovery code
        &lt;/label&gt;
        &lt;input
          id="code"
          type="text"
          required
          value={verificationCode}
          onChange={<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >(e</span>) =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >setVerificationCode(e.target.value)}</span>
          placeholder="Enter the 6-digit code"
          className="block w-full bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-700 rounded-lg text-gray-900 dark:text-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-cyan-500 dark:focus:ring-cyan-400 focus:border-transparent transition-all duration-200 shadow-sm p-2.5 text-center tracking-widest text-lg"
          maxLength={6}
        /&gt;
      &lt;/div&gt;
&nbsp;
      &lt;button
        type="submit"
        disabled={isLoading || !isLoaded || !verificationCode}
        className="w-full bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-500 to-blue-600 hover:from-cyan-600 hover:to-blue-700 text-white font-medium shadow-md hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-200 py-2.5 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center disabled:opacity-70 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
      &gt;
        {isLoading ? (
          &lt;span className="inline-block h-5 w-5 border-2 border-white border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin mr-2"&gt;&lt;/span&gt;
        ) : null}
        Verify Code
        &lt;ArrowRight className="ml-2 h-5 w-5" /&gt;
      &lt;/button&gt;
&nbsp;
      &lt;button
        type="button"
        onClick={<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >() =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >s</span>etStep("request")}</span>
        className="w-full text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-800 dark:hover:text-gray-200 font-medium py-2 flex items-center justify-center"
      &gt;
        &lt;ArrowLeft className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" /&gt;
        Back to reset request
      &lt;/button&gt;
    &lt;/form&gt;
  );
&nbsp;
  const renderResetPasswordForm = () =&gt; (
    &lt;form onSubmit={handleResetPassword} className="space-y-6"&gt;
      &lt;div className="p-4 bg-green-50 dark:bg-green-900/20 border border-green-200 dark:border-green-800/30 text-green-800 dark:text-green-300 rounded-lg flex items-start mb-6"&gt;
        &lt;Check className="w-5 h-5 mr-2 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0" /&gt;
        &lt;div&gt;
          &lt;p className="text-sm font-medium"&gt;Code verified successfully&lt;/p&gt;
          &lt;p className="text-sm"&gt;Please set your new password&lt;/p&gt;
        &lt;/div&gt;
      &lt;/div&gt;
&nbsp;
      &lt;div&gt;
        &lt;label htmlFor="password" className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-200 mb-1"&gt;
          New password
        &lt;/label&gt;
        &lt;div className="relative"&gt;
          &lt;div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none"&gt;
            &lt;Lock className="h-5 w-5 text-gray-400" /&gt;
          &lt;/div&gt;
          &lt;input
            id="password"
            type={showPassword ? "text" : "password"}
            required
            value={password}
            onChange={<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >(e</span>) =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >setPassword(e.target.value)}</span>
            placeholder="Create a new password"
            className="block w-full pl-10 pr-10 bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-700 rounded-lg text-gray-900 dark:text-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-cyan-500 dark:focus:ring-cyan-400 focus:border-transparent transition-all duration-200 shadow-sm p-2.5"
          /&gt;
          &lt;div className="absolute inset-y-0 right-0 pr-3 flex items-center"&gt;
            &lt;button
              type="button"
              onClick={<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >() =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >s</span>etShowPassword(!showPassword)}</span>
              className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-500 dark:hover:text-gray-400"
            &gt;
              {showPassword ? (
<span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >                &lt;EyeOff className="h-5 w-5" /&gt;</span>
              ) : (
                &lt;Eye className="h-5 w-5" /&gt;
              )}
            &lt;/button&gt;
          &lt;/div&gt;
        &lt;/div&gt;
        &lt;p className="mt-2 text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400"&gt;
          Password must be at least 8 characters
        &lt;/p&gt;
      &lt;/div&gt;
&nbsp;
      &lt;button
        type="submit"
        disabled={isLoading || !isLoaded || password.length &lt; 8}
        className="w-full bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-500 to-blue-600 hover:from-cyan-600 hover:to-blue-700 text-white font-medium shadow-md hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-200 py-2.5 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center disabled:opacity-70 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
      &gt;
        {isLoading ? (
          &lt;span className="inline-block h-5 w-5 border-2 border-white border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin mr-2"&gt;&lt;/span&gt;
        ) : null}
        Reset Password
        &lt;ArrowRight className="ml-2 h-5 w-5" /&gt;
      &lt;/button&gt;
    &lt;/form&gt;
  );
&nbsp;
  return (
    &lt;div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-gradient-to-br from-gray-50 to-indigo-50 dark:from-gray-900 dark:to-indigo-950 p-4"&gt;
      &lt;div className="absolute inset-0 bg-[radial-gradient(#e5e7eb_1px,transparent_1px)] dark:bg-[radial-gradient(#2a2a3a_1px,transparent_1px)] [background-size:40px_40px] [mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse_50%_50%_at_50%_50%,#000_70%,transparent_100%)]"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
&nbsp;
      &lt;div className="relative z-10 w-full max-w-md"&gt;
        &lt;div className="bg-white dark:bg-gray-900 shadow-2xl rounded-xl border border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-800 p-8"&gt;
          &lt;div className="mb-8 text-center"&gt;
            &lt;h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white mb-2"&gt;
              {step === "request" ? "Reset your password" :
                step === "verify" ? "Verify your identity" :
                  "Set new password"}
            &lt;/h1&gt;
            &lt;p className="text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300"&gt;
              {step === "request" ? "Enter your email to receive a recovery code" :
                step === "verify" ? "Enter the code we sent to your email" :
                  "Create a new secure password"}
            &lt;/p&gt;
          &lt;/div&gt;
&nbsp;
          {<span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >error &amp;&amp; (</span>
            &lt;div className="mb-6 p-4 bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/20 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-800/30 text-red-800 dark:text-red-300 rounded-lg flex items-start"&gt;
              &lt;AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 mr-2 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0" /&gt;
              &lt;span className="text-sm"&gt;{error}&lt;/span&gt;
            &lt;/div&gt;
          )}
&nbsp;
          {successMessage &amp;&amp; step === "reset" &amp;&amp; (
            &lt;div className="mb-6 p-4 bg-green-50 dark:bg-green-900/20 border border-green-200 dark:border-green-800/30 text-green-800 dark:text-green-300 rounded-lg flex items-start"&gt;
              &lt;Check className="w-5 h-5 mr-2 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0" /&gt;
              &lt;span className="text-sm"&gt;{successMessage}&lt;/span&gt;
            &lt;/div&gt;
          )}

          {step === "request" &amp;&amp; renderRequestResetForm()}
          {step === "verify" &amp;&amp; renderVerifyCodeForm()}
          {step === "reset" &amp;&amp; renderResetPasswordForm()}
&nbsp;
          &lt;div className="mt-8 text-center"&gt;
            &lt;p className="text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400"&gt;
              Remember your password?{" "}
              &lt;Link
                href="/custom-auth/sign-in"
                className="text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-400 hover:text-cyan-700 dark:hover:text-cyan-300 font-medium"
              &gt;
                Sign in
              &lt;/Link&gt;
            &lt;/p&gt;
          &lt;/div&gt;
        &lt;/div&gt;

                  onClick={<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >() =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >r</span>outer.push(`/chat?with=${user.userId}`)}</span>
                  className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-blue-400 rounded transition-colors"
                  title="Start chat"
                &gt;
                  &lt;Send className="w-3 h-3" /&gt;
                &lt;/button&gt;
                &lt;button
                  onClick={<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >() =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >v</span>isitProfile(user.userId)}</span>
                  className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-purple-400 rounded transition-colors"
                  title="Visit profile"
                &gt;
                  &lt;User className="w-3 h-3" /&gt;
                &lt;/button&gt;
              &lt;/div&gt;
            &lt;/div&gt;
          ))}
        &lt;/div&gt;
      )}
&nbsp;
      {/* Learning Partners (Following) */}
      {loading ? (
        &lt;div className="text-center py-6"&gt;
          &lt;div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-6 w-6 border-2 border-blue-500 border-t-transparent mx-auto"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
        &lt;/div&gt;
      ) : followingUsers.length &gt; 0 ? (
        &lt;div className="space-y-2"&gt;
          &lt;p className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-medium"&gt;Learning Partners&lt;/p&gt;
          {followingUsers.map((user) =&gt; (
            &lt;div
              key={user.userId}
              className="flex items-center gap-3 p-2 hover:bg-slate-800/30 rounded-lg transition-colors group"
            &gt;
              &lt;img
                src={user.avatarUrl || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >"https://i.pravatar.cc/150?img=1"}</span>
                alt={user.fullName}
                className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full"
              /&gt;
              &lt;div className="flex-1 min-w-0"&gt;
                &lt;p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-100 truncate"&gt;{user.fullName}&lt;/p&gt;
                &lt;p className="text-xs text-slate-500"&gt;Active learning partner&lt;/p&gt;
              &lt;/div&gt;
              &lt;div className="flex gap-1 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity"&gt;
                &lt;button
                  onClick={() =&gt; router.push(`/chat?with=${user.userId}`)}
                  className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-blue-400 rounded transition-colors"
                  title="Start chat"
                &gt;
                  &lt;Send className="w-3 h-3" /&gt;
                &lt;/button&gt;
                &lt;button
                  onClick={() =&gt; visitProfile(user.userId)}
                  className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-purple-400 rounded transition-colors"
                  title="Visit profile"
                &gt;
                  &lt;User className="w-3 h-3" /&gt;
                &lt;/button&gt;
              &lt;/div&gt;
            &lt;/div&gt;
          ))}
        &lt;/div&gt;
      ) : (
        &lt;div className="text-center py-6"&gt;
          &lt;User className="w-8 h-8 text-slate-400 mx-auto mb-2" /&gt;
          &lt;p className="text-sm text-slate-400"&gt;No learning partners yet&lt;/p&gt;
          &lt;p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1"&gt;Follow users to see them here&lt;/p&gt;
        &lt;/div&gt;
      )}
&nbsp;
      {/* Recent Conversations */}
      {recentChats.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; (
        &lt;div className="space-y-2 pt-4 border-t border-slate-700/30"&gt;
          &lt;p className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-medium"&gt;Recent Conversations&lt;/p&gt;
          {recentChats.slice(0, 3).map((chat) =&gt; (
            &lt;div
              key={chat.userId}
              onClick={<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >() =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >r</span>outer.push(`/chat?with=${chat.userId}`)}</span>
              className="flex items-start gap-3 p-2 hover:bg-slate-800/30 rounded-lg cursor-pointer transition-colors group"
            &gt;
              &lt;img
                src={chat.avatarUrl || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >"https://i.pravatar.cc/150?img=1"}</span>
                alt={chat.fullName}
                className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full"
              /&gt;
              &lt;div className="flex-1 min-w-0"&gt;
                &lt;div className="flex items-center justify-between"&gt;
                  &lt;p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-100 truncate"&gt;{chat.fullName}&lt;/p&gt;
                  {chat.lastMessageTime &amp;&amp; (
                    &lt;p className="text-xs text-slate-500"&gt;{formatTime(chat.lastMessageTime)}&lt;/p&gt;
                  )}
                &lt;/div&gt;
                {chat.lastMessage &amp;&amp; (
                  &lt;p className="text-xs text-slate-500 truncate"&gt;{chat.lastMessage}&lt;/p&gt;
                )}
              &lt;/div&gt;
              {!chat.isRead &amp;&amp; (
                &lt;div className="w-2 h-2 bg-blue-500 rounded-full mt-2"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
              )}
            &lt;/div&gt;
          ))}
        &lt;/div&gt;
      )}
    &lt;/div&gt;
  );
} </pre></td></tr></table></pre>

  name: string;
  description: string;
  meetingType: string;
  nextMeeting: string;
  meetingTime: string;
  currentParticipants: number;
  maxParticipants: number;
  subjectName: string;
  subjectColor: string;
  creatorName: string;
  creatorAvatar: string;
  memberRole: string;
  joinedAt: string;

&nbsp;
export default function MyStudyGroups() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [myGroups, setMyGroups] = useState&lt;StudyGroup[]&gt;([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
&nbsp;
  useEffect(() =&gt; {
    fetchMyGroups();
  }, []);
&nbsp;
  const fetchMyGroups = async () =&gt; {
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/community/study-groups?type=my-groups');
      if (response.ok) {
        const data = await response.json();
        setMyGroups(data.groups || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >[])</span>;

    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching my study groups:', error);

    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (!dateString) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >return 'TBD';</span>

      month: 'short',
      day: 'numeric',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit'
    });
  };
&nbsp;
  const getSubjectInitial = (subjectName: string) =&gt; {
    return subjectName ? subjectName.charAt(0).toUpperCase() : <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >'S';</span>
  };
&nbsp;
  const getSubjectColor = (color: string) =&gt; {
    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (color &amp;&amp; color.startsWith('#')) {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return `bg-[${color}]`;</span>
    }

    const colors = [
      'bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-500 to-purple-600',
      'bg-gradient-to-r from-red-500 to-pink-600',
      'bg-gradient-to-r from-yellow-500 to-orange-600',
      'bg-gradient-to-r from-green-500 to-emerald-600',
      'bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-500 to-indigo-600',
    ];
    return colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)];
  };
&nbsp;

        &lt;div data-testid="loading-spinner" className="animate-spin rounded-full h-6 w-6 border-2 border-emerald-500 border-t-transparent mx-auto"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
      &lt;/div&gt;
    );
  }
&nbsp;

        &lt;Users className="w-8 h-8 text-slate-400 mx-auto mb-2" /&gt;

      &lt;/div&gt;
    );

              &lt;div className="flex items-start justify-between"&gt;

import { useAuth } from "@clerk/nextjs";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useEffect, useState, ReactNode } from "react";
import { Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
&nbsp;
interface AuthCheckProps {
  children: ReactNode;
  fallback?: ReactNode;
  loadingComponent?: ReactNode;
}
&nbsp;
export default function AuthCheck({
  children,
  fallback,
  loadingComponent
}: AuthCheckProps) {
  const { isLoaded, isSignedIn } = useAuth();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [isChecking, setIsChecking] = useState(true);
&nbsp;
  useEffect(() =&gt; {
    if (isLoaded) {
      setIsChecking(false);
      if (!isSignedIn &amp;&amp; !fallback) {
        // If no fallback is provided, redirect to sign-in
        router.push("/custom-auth/sign-in");
      }
    }
  }, [isLoaded, isSignedIn, router, fallback]);
&nbsp;
  if (!isLoaded || isChecking) {
    // Show loading state while checking auth
    return (
      loadingComponent || (
        &lt;div className="flex justify-center items-center min-h-screen"&gt;
          &lt;Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-400" /&gt;
          &lt;span className="ml-2 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300"&gt;Checking authentication...&lt;/span&gt;
        &lt;/div&gt;
      )
    );
  }
&nbsp;
  // If signed in, show the protected content
  if (isSignedIn) {
    return &lt;&gt;{children}&lt;/&gt;;
  }
&nbsp;
  // If not signed in and fallback is provided, show the fallback
  if (fallback) {
    return &lt;&gt;{fallback}&lt;/&gt;;
  }
&nbsp;
  // This should not be reached if there's a redirect in the useEffect
  return null;
} </pre></td></tr></table></pre>

  User

interface AudioCallProps {
  channelName: string;
  userId: string;
  onCallEnd: () =&gt; void;
  appId: string;
  token?: string;
  recipientName?: string;
}

  const [connectionError, setConnectionError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);
&nbsp;
  const connectLockRef = useRef(false);

            const tokenData = await tokenResponse.json();
            finalToken = tokenData.token;
            finalUid = tokenData.uid;

<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            console.error('Audio token generation failed:', tokenErr);</span>

<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            await cleanup();</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            return;</span>
          }

&nbsp;

<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        if (error.code === 'CAN_NOT_GET_GATEWAY_SERVER') {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          errorMessage += 'Gateway server error - this usually means the App ID is invalid or requires a token.';</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          actionMessage = 'Solutions:\n• Verify your Agora App ID is correct\n• Create a new App ID from Agora Console\n• For production, implement token authentication\n• Try using a different App ID';</span>

            : 'bg-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-700 text-white'

          title={isSpeakerEnabled ? 'Switch to earpiece' : 'Switch to speaker'}
        &gt;
          {isSpeakerEnabled ? &lt;Volume2 className="w-6 h-6" /&gt; : &lt;VolumeX className="w-6 h-6" /&gt;}
        &lt;/button&gt;
&nbsp;
        {/* Mute Toggle */}
        &lt;button
          onClick={toggleAudio}
          className={`p-6 rounded-full transition-colors ${isAudioEnabled
            ? 'bg-white/20 hover:bg-white/30 text-white'
            : 'bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white'
            }`}
          title={isAudioEnabled ? 'Mute' : 'Unmute'}
        &gt;
          {isAudioEnabled ? &lt;Mic className="w-8 h-8" /&gt; : &lt;MicOff className="w-8 h-8" /&gt;}
        &lt;/button&gt;
&nbsp;
        {/* End Call */}
        &lt;button
          onClick={endCall}
          className="p-6 rounded-full bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white transition-colors"
          title="End call"
        &gt;
          &lt;PhoneOff className="w-8 h-8" /&gt;
        &lt;/button&gt;
      &lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;
  );

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Phone, PhoneOff, Video, VideoOff } from 'lucide-react';
&nbsp;
interface IncomingCallNotificationProps {
  callerName: string;
  callerAvatar?: string;
  isVideoCall: boolean;
  onAccept: () =&gt; void;
  onDecline: () =&gt; void;
  onShow?: () =&gt; void;
}
&nbsp;
export default function IncomingCallNotification({
  callerName,
  callerAvatar,
  isVideoCall,
  onAccept,
  onDecline,
  onShow
}: IncomingCallNotificationProps) {
  const [isVisible, setIsVisible] = useState(false);
  const [isRinging, setIsRinging] = useState(false);
&nbsp;
  console.log('🔔 IncomingCallNotification component mounted with props:', {
    callerName,
    callerAvatar,
    isVideoCall
  });
&nbsp;
  useEffect(() =&gt; {
    console.log('🚀 IncomingCallNotification useEffect - showing notification');
    // Show notification with animation
    setIsVisible(true);
    setIsRinging(true);
    onShow?.();
&nbsp;
    // Auto-decline after 30 seconds
    const autoDeclineTimer = setTimeout(() =&gt; {
      console.log('⏰ Auto-declining call after 30 seconds');
      handleDecline();
    }, 30000);
&nbsp;
    return () =&gt; {
      clearTimeout(autoDeclineTimer);
      setIsRinging(false);
    };
  }, []);
&nbsp;
  const handleAccept = () =&gt; {
    console.log('✅ Call accepted');
    setIsRinging(false);
    setIsVisible(false);
    onAccept();
  };
&nbsp;
  const handleDecline = () =&gt; {
    console.log('❌ Call declined');
    setIsRinging(false);
    setIsVisible(false);
    onDecline();
  };
&nbsp;
  if (!isVisible) {
    console.log('👻 Notification not visible, returning null');
    return null;
  }
&nbsp;
  console.log('🎨 Rendering notification popup');
&nbsp;
  return (
    &lt;&gt;
      {/* Backdrop */}
      &lt;div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm z-[100]" /&gt;
&nbsp;
      {/* Notification */}
      &lt;div className="fixed inset-0 flex items-center justify-center z-[101] p-4"&gt;
        &lt;div
          className={`bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-2xl max-w-sm w-full mx-auto transform transition-all duration-500 ${isVisible ? 'scale-100 opacity-100' : <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >'scale-95 opacity-0'</span>
            }`}
        &gt;
          {/* Caller Info */}
          &lt;div className="text-center mb-6"&gt;
            &lt;div className="relative mb-4"&gt;
              &lt;div className={`w-24 h-24 mx-auto rounded-full overflow-hidden ${isRinging ? 'animate-pulse' : <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >''}`}</span>&gt;
                &lt;img
                  src={callerAvatar || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >'/api/placeholder/96/96'}</span>
                  alt={callerName}
                  className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                /&gt;
              &lt;/div&gt;
              {/* Ringing animation overlay */}
              {isRinging &amp;&amp; (
                &lt;div className="absolute inset-0 rounded-full border-4 border-blue-500 animate-ping opacity-75" /&gt;
              )}
            &lt;/div&gt;
&nbsp;
            &lt;h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white mb-1"&gt;
              {callerName}
            &lt;/h3&gt;
&nbsp;
            &lt;p className="text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-slate-400 flex items-center justify-center gap-2"&gt;
              {isVideoCall ? (
                &lt;&gt;
                  &lt;Video className="w-4 h-4" /&gt;
                  Incoming video call
                &lt;/&gt;
              ) : (
                &lt;&gt;
                  &lt;Phone className="w-4 h-4" /&gt;
                  Incoming audio call
                &lt;/&gt;
              )}
            &lt;/p&gt;
          &lt;/div&gt;
&nbsp;
          {/* Call Actions */}
          &lt;div className="flex justify-center gap-4"&gt;
            {/* Decline Button */}
            &lt;button
              onClick={handleDecline}
              className="flex items-center justify-center w-16 h-16 bg-red-500 hover:bg-red-600 text-white rounded-full transition-all duration-200 shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl transform hover:scale-105"
              title="Decline call"
            &gt;
              &lt;PhoneOff className="w-6 h-6" /&gt;
            &lt;/button&gt;
&nbsp;
            {/* Accept Button */}
            &lt;button
              onClick={handleAccept}
              className="flex items-center justify-center w-16 h-16 bg-green-500 hover:bg-green-600 text-white rounded-full transition-all duration-200 shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl transform hover:scale-105"
              title="Accept call"
            &gt;
              {isVideoCall ? (
                &lt;Video className="w-6 h-6" /&gt;
              ) : (
                &lt;Phone className="w-6 h-6" /&gt;
              )}
            &lt;/button&gt;
          &lt;/div&gt;
&nbsp;
          {/* Auto-decline timer */}
          &lt;div className="mt-4 text-center"&gt;
            &lt;p className="text-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-slate-500"&gt;
              Auto-decline in 30 seconds
            &lt;/p&gt;
          &lt;/div&gt;
        &lt;/div&gt;
      &lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;/&gt;
  );
} </pre></td></tr></table></pre>

const FeatureCarousel = () =&gt; {
  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(0);
  const carouselRef = useRef&lt;HTMLDivElement&gt;(null);
  const [visibleCards, setVisibleCards] = useState(1);
  const totalFeatures = FEATURES.length;
&nbsp;
  // Determine visible cards based on screen width
  useEffect(() =&gt; {
    const handleResize = () =&gt; {
      const width = window.innerWidth;
      console.log("Width:", width); // Debugging line
      <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (width &gt;= 1024) {
        // large screens - 4 cards

      } else <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (width &gt;= 768 &amp;&amp; <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >width &lt; 1024) {</span>

<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        setVisibleCards(3);</span>
      } else <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (width &gt;= 640 &amp;&amp; <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >width &lt; 768) {</span>
        // medium-small screens - 2 cards{
        // medium screens - 2 cards
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        setVisibleCards(2);</span>
      } else {
        // small screens - 1 card
        setVisibleCards(1);
      }
    };
&nbsp;
    handleResize(); // Initial check
    window.addEventListener("resize", handleResize);
    return () =&gt; window.removeEventListener("resize", handleResize);
  }, []);
&nbsp;
  const handleNext = <span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >() =&gt; {</span>
    // Only increment if we haven't reached the end
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (activeIndex + visibleCards &lt; totalFeatures) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      setActiveIndex(<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >(p</span>revIndex) =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >prevIndex + 1);</span></span>
    } else {
      // Loop back to the beginning
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      setActiveIndex(0);</span>

&nbsp;
  const handlePrev = <span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >() =&gt; {</span>

&nbsp;
interface UploadedFile {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  size: number;
  type: string;
  url: string;
  downloadUrl: string;
  previewUrl?: string;
}
&nbsp;
interface UseFileUploadReturn {
  uploading: boolean;
  progress: number;
  error: string | null;
  uploadedFile: UploadedFile | null;
  uploadFile: (file: File) =&gt; Promise&lt;UploadedFile | null&gt;;
  deleteFile: (fileId: string) =&gt; Promise&lt;boolean&gt;;
  reset: () =&gt; void;
}
&nbsp;
export const useFileUpload = (): UseFileUploadReturn =&gt; {
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0);
  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);
  const [uploadedFile, setUploadedFile] = useState&lt;UploadedFile | null&gt;(null);
&nbsp;
  const uploadFile = async (file: File): Promise&lt;UploadedFile | null&gt; =&gt; {
    setUploading(true);
    setProgress(0);
    setError(null);
&nbsp;
    try {
      // Validate file size
      const maxSize = 10 * 1024 * 1024; // 10MB
      <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (file.size &gt; maxSize) {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        throw new Error('File too large. Maximum size is 10MB.');</span>
      }
&nbsp;
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append('file', file);
&nbsp;
      // Upload file using fetch with progress tracking
      const response = await fetch('/api/upload', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: formData,
      });
&nbsp;
      if (!response.ok) {
        const errorData = await response.json();
        throw new Error(errorData.error || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >'Upload failed');</span>
      }
&nbsp;
      const result = await response.json();
&nbsp;
      if (result.success) {
        setUploadedFile(result.file);
        setProgress(100);
        return result.file;
      } else <span class="missing-if-branch" title="else path not taken" >E</span>{
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        throw new Error(result.error || 'Upload failed');</span>
      }
&nbsp;
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Upload error:', err);
      setError(err.message);
      return null;
    } finally {
      setUploading(false);
    }
  };
&nbsp;
  const deleteFile = async (fileId: string): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; =&gt; {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`/api/upload?fileId=${fileId}`, {
        method: 'DELETE',
      });
&nbsp;
      if (!response.ok) {
        const errorData = await response.json();
        throw new Error(errorData.error || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >'Delete failed');</span>
      }
&nbsp;
      const result = await response.json();
&nbsp;
      if (result.success) {
        setUploadedFile(null);
        return true;
      } else <span class="missing-if-branch" title="else path not taken" >E</span>{
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        throw new Error(result.error || 'Delete failed');</span>
      }
&nbsp;
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Delete error:', err);
      setError(err.message);
      return false;
    }
  };
&nbsp;
  const reset = () =&gt; {
    setUploading(false);
    setProgress(0);
    setError(null);
    setUploadedFile(null);
  };
&nbsp;

import {
  usersTable,
  threadsTable,
  commentsTable,
  doubtSolvingSessionsTable,
  doubtSolvingMessagesTable,
  chatsTable,
  messagesTable
} from '@/db/schema';
import { eq, desc, asc, count, and, or, ilike, sql } from 'drizzle-orm';
&nbsp;
// User Operations
export async function findUserByClerkId(clerkId: string) {
  const users = await db
    .select()
    .from(usersTable)
    .where(eq(usersTable.clerkId, clerkId))
    .limit(1);
&nbsp;
  return users[0] || null;
}
&nbsp;
export async function findUserByEmail(email: string) {
  const users = await db
    .select()
    .from(usersTable)
    .where(eq(usersTable.email, email))
    .limit(1);
&nbsp;
  return users[0] || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >null;</span>
}
&nbsp;
export async function createUser(userData: {
  clerkId?: string;
  fullName: string;
  email: string;
  role?: 'student' | 'teacher' | 'admin';
}) {
  const newUsers = await db
    .insert(usersTable)
    .values({
      clerkId: userData.clerkId,
      fullName: userData.fullName,
      email: userData.email,
      role: userData.role || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >'student',</span>
    })
    .returning();
&nbsp;
  return newUsers[0];
}
&nbsp;
export async function updateUser(userId: string, updates: Partial&lt;{
  fullName: string;
  email: string;
  lastActiveAt: Date;
  avatarUrl: string;
  isLocked: boolean;
}&gt;) {
  const updatedUsers = await db
    .update(usersTable)
    .set({
      ...updates,
      // Always update the timestamp when updating user
      lastActiveAt: new Date(),
    })
    .where(eq(usersTable.userId, userId))
    .returning();
&nbsp;
  return updatedUsers[0] || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >null;</span>
}
&nbsp;
// Thread Operations
export async function getThreads(options: {
  limit?: number;
  offset?: number;
  sortBy?: 'recent' | 'popular' | 'mostComments';
  search?: string;
}) {
  const { limit = 10, offset = 0, sortBy = 'recent', search } = options;
&nbsp;
  let query = db
    .select({
      threadId: threadsTable.threadId,
      title: threadsTable.title,
      body: threadsTable.body,
      createdBy: threadsTable.createdBy,
      createdAt: threadsTable.createdAt,
      updatedAt: threadsTable.updatedAt,
      likeCount: threadsTable.likeCount,
      commentCount: threadsTable.commentCount,
      viewCount: threadsTable.viewCount,
      isPinned: threadsTable.isPinned,
      isLocked: threadsTable.isLocked,
    })
    .from(threadsTable);
&nbsp;
  // Add search filter if provided
  if (search) {
    query = query.where(
      or(
        ilike(threadsTable.title, `%${search}%`),
        ilike(threadsTable.body, `%${search}%`)
      )
    );
  }
&nbsp;
  // Add sorting
  switch (sortBy) {
<span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >    case 'popular':</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      query = query.orderBy(desc(threadsTable.likeCount));</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      break;</span>
<span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >    case 'mostComments':</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      query = query.orderBy(desc(threadsTable.commentCount));</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      break;</span>
    default:
      query = query.orderBy(desc(threadsTable.createdAt));
  }
&nbsp;
  // Add pagination
  query = query.limit(limit).offset(offset);
&nbsp;
  return await query;
}
&nbsp;
export async function getThreadCount(search?: string) {
  let query = db
    .select({ count: count() })
    .from(threadsTable);
&nbsp;
  if (search) {
    query = query.where(
      or(
        ilike(threadsTable.title, `%${search}%`),
        ilike(threadsTable.body, `%${search}%`)
      )
    );
  }
&nbsp;
  const result = await query;
  return result[0]?.count || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >0;</span>
}
&nbsp;
export async function getThreadById(threadId: string) {
  const threads = await db
    .select()
    .from(threadsTable)
    .where(eq(threadsTable.threadId, threadId))
    .limit(1);
&nbsp;

export async function checkTablesExist() {

      SELECT table_name 
      FROM information_schema.tables 
      WHERE table_schema = 'public'

    `);

    const existingTables = new Set(result.rows.map(row =&gt; row.table_name));

      users: existingTables.has('users'),
      threads: existingTables.has('threads'),
      sessions: existingTables.has('doubt_solving_sessions'),
    };

import { sql } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { auth } from '@clerk/nextjs/server';
&nbsp;
export async function syncUserToDatabase(retries = 3): Promise&lt;{ success: boolean; message: string; userId?: string }&gt; {
  for (let attempt = 1; attempt &lt;= retries; attempt++) {
    try {
      // Get the current user from Clerk
      const { userId } = await auth();
&nbsp;
      if (!userId) {
        return { success: false, message: 'No user found to sync' };
      }
&nbsp;
      // Check if user already exists in database by clerkId
      const existingUserByClerkId = await db.execute(sql`
        SELECT "user_id" FROM users WHERE "clerk_id" = ${userId} LIMIT 1
      `);
&nbsp;
      if (existingUserByClerkId.rows &amp;&amp; existingUserByClerkId.rows.length &gt; 0) {
        // User exists with this clerkId, update their info
        const result = await db.execute(sql`
          UPDATE users SET 
            "last_active_at" = NOW()
          WHERE "clerk_id" = ${userId}
          RETURNING "user_id", "clerk_id", "full_name", email
        `);
&nbsp;
        const updatedUser = result.rows[0];
        console.log('User updated in database:', updatedUser);
&nbsp;
        return {
          success: true,
          message: 'User updated successfully',
          userId: updatedUser.user_id as string
        };
      }
&nbsp;
      // User doesn't exist, create new user with minimal required fields
      const result = await db.execute(sql`
        INSERT INTO users ("clerk_id", "full_name", email, role, "is_locked", "joined_at", "last_active_at")
        VALUES (
          ${userId},
          'User',
          '',
          'student',
          false,
          NOW(),
          NOW()
        )
        RETURNING "user_id", "clerk_id", "full_name", email
      `);
&nbsp;
      const newUser = result.rows[0];
      console.log('User synced to database:', newUser);
&nbsp;
      return {
        success: true,
        message: 'User created successfully',
        userId: newUser.user_id as string
      };
&nbsp;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`User sync attempt ${attempt} failed:`, error);
&nbsp;
      if (attempt === retries) {
        return {
          success: false,
          message: `Failed to sync user after ${retries} attempts: ${error}`
        };
      }
&nbsp;
      // Wait before retrying (exponential backoff)
      await new Promise(resolve =&gt; setTimeout(resolve, Math.pow(2, attempt) * 1000));
    }
  }
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  return { success: false, message: 'Unexpected error during user sync' };</span>
}
&nbsp;
export async function ensureUserExists(clerkId: string): Promise&lt;{ exists: boolean; userId?: string }&gt; {
  try {
    const existingUser = await db.execute(sql`
      SELECT "user_id" FROM users WHERE "clerk_id" = ${clerkId} LIMIT 1
    `);
&nbsp;
    if (existingUser.rows &amp;&amp; existingUser.rows.length &gt; 0) {
      return { exists: true, userId: existingUser.rows[0].user_id as string };
    }
&nbsp;
    return { exists: false };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error checking if user exists:', error);
    return { exists: false };
  }

/**
 * Downloads a file from a URL by fetching it as a blob and creating a download link
 * @param url - The URL of the file to download
 * @param filename - The desired filename for the download
 * @param fallbackUrl - Optional fallback URL to open in new tab if download fails
 */
export async function downloadFile(url: string, filename: string, fallbackUrl?: string): Promise&lt;void&gt; {
  try {
    console.log(`📥 Starting download: ${filename}`);
&nbsp;
    const response = await fetch(url);
    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`);
    }
&nbsp;
    const blob = await response.blob();
    const downloadUrl = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = downloadUrl;
    link.download = filename;
&nbsp;
    // Add the link to DOM temporarily
    document.body.appendChild(link);
&nbsp;
    // Trigger download
    link.click();
&nbsp;
    // Clean up
    document.body.removeChild(link);
    try {
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(downloadUrl);
    } catch (error) {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      console.warn('Could not revoke object URL:', error);</span>
    }
&nbsp;
    console.log(`✅ Download initiated: ${filename}`);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('❌ Download failed:', error);
&nbsp;
    // Show user-friendly error message
    const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >'Unknown error';</span>
    console.warn(`Download failed for ${filename}: ${errorMessage}. Opening in new tab instead.`);
&nbsp;
    // Fallback to opening in new tab
    if (fallbackUrl) {
      try {
        const fallbackResponse = await fetch(fallbackUrl);
        if (fallbackResponse.ok) {
          const fallbackBlob = await fallbackResponse.blob();
          const fallbackDownloadUrl = window.URL.createObjectURL(fallbackBlob);
          const fallbackLink = document.createElement('a');
          fallbackLink.href = fallbackDownloadUrl;
          fallbackLink.download = filename;
          document.body.appendChild(fallbackLink);
          fallbackLink.click();
          document.body.removeChild(fallbackLink);
          window.URL.revokeObjectURL(fallbackDownloadUrl);
        } else <span class="missing-if-branch" title="else path not taken" >E</span>{
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          window.open(fallbackUrl, '_blank');</span>
        }
      } catch (fallbackError) {
        window.open(fallbackUrl, '_blank');
      }
    } else {
      window.open(url, '_blank');
    }
  }
}

                &lt;div ref={messagesEndRef} /&gt;
              &lt;/div&gt;
&nbsp;
              {/* Message Input */}
              &lt;div className="p-4 bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/80 backdrop-blur border-t border-gray-200/30 dark:border-slate-700/30"&gt;
                {/* File Previews */}
                {<span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >selectedFiles.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; (</span>
                  &lt;div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2"&gt;
                    {selectedFiles.map(<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >(f</span>ileUpload, index) =&gt; (
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >                      &lt;div key={index} c</span>lassName="relative bg-gray-100 dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg p-3 flex items-center gap-3 max-w-xs"&gt;
                        &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-1 min-w-0"&gt;
                          {fileUpload.preview ? (
<span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >                            &lt;img src={fileUpload.preview} alt="" className="w-10 h-10 rounded object-cover" /&gt;</span>
                          ) : (
                            &lt;div className={`w-10 h-10 rounded flex items-center justify-center ${fileUpload.file.type === 'application/pdf'
                              ? 'bg-red-100 dark:bg-red-900/30'
                              : 'bg-gray-200 dark:bg-slate-700'
                              }`}&gt;
                              {getFileIcon(fileUpload.file.type)}
                            &lt;/div&gt;
                          )}
                          &lt;div className="flex-1 min-w-0"&gt;
                            &lt;p className="text-xs font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-white truncate"&gt;
                              {fileUpload.file.type === 'application/pdf' ? '📄 ' : ''}{fileUpload.file.name}
                            &lt;/p&gt;
                            &lt;p className="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-slate-400"&gt;
                              {fileUpload.file.type === 'application/pdf' &amp;&amp; 'PDF • '}{formatFileSize(fileUpload.file.size)}
                            &lt;/p&gt;
                          &lt;/div&gt;
                        &lt;/div&gt;
                        &lt;button
                          onClick={<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >() =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >r</span>emoveFile(index)}</span>
                          className="p-1 text-gray-400 hover:text-red-500 transition-colors"
                        &gt;
                          &lt;X className="w-4 h-4" /&gt;
                        &lt;/button&gt;
                      &lt;/div&gt;
                    ))}
                  &lt;/div&gt;
                )}
&nbsp;
                &lt;div className="flex gap-3"&gt;
                  {/* File Input */}
                  &lt;input
                    ref={fileInputRef}
                    type="file"
                    multiple
                    onChange={handleFileSelect}
                    className="hidden"
                    accept="image/*,.pdf,.doc,.docx,.txt,.zip"
                  /&gt;
&nbsp;
                  {/* File Button */}
                  &lt;button
                    onClick={<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >() =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >f</span>ileInputRef.current?.click()}</span>
                    disabled={uploadingFiles || sendingMessage}
                    className="p-3 text-gray-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-gray-900 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-700/50 rounded-xl transition-colors disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                  &gt;
                    &lt;Paperclip className="w-5 h-5" /&gt;
                  &lt;/button&gt;
&nbsp;
                  &lt;div className="flex-1 relative"&gt;
                    &lt;textarea
                      value={newMessage}
                      onChange={<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >(e</span>) =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >setNewMessage(e.target.value)}</span>
                      onKeyPress={handleKeyPress}
                      placeholder={`Message ${selectedUser.fullName}...`}
                      className="w-full px-4 py-3 bg-gray-100 dark:bg-slate-800/60 rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/50 text-gray-900 dark:text-white placeholder-gray-500 dark:placeholder-slate-400 resize-none max-h-32"
                      rows={1}
                      style={{ height: 'auto', minHeight: '2.75rem' }}
                      onInput={<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >(e</span>) =&gt; {
                        const target = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >e.target </span>as HTMLTextAreaElement;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >                        target.style.height = 'auto';</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >                        target.style.height = target.scrollHeight + 'px';</span>
                      }}
                    /&gt;
                  &lt;/div&gt;
                  &lt;button
                    onClick={sendMessage}
                    disabled={(!newMessage.trim() &amp;&amp; selectedFiles.length === 0) || sendingMessage || uploadingFiles}
                    className="px-4 py-3 bg-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-600 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed text-white rounded-xl transition-colors flex items-center justify-center min-w-[3rem]"
                  &gt;
                    {(sendingMessage || uploadingFiles) ? (
<span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >                      &lt;div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-5 w-5 border-2 border-white border-t-transparent"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;</span>
                    ) : (
                      &lt;Send className="w-5 h-5" /&gt;
                    )}
                  &lt;/button&gt;
                &lt;/div&gt;
              &lt;/div&gt;
            &lt;/&gt;
          ) : (
            /* No Chat Selected */
            &lt;div className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center"&gt;
              &lt;div className="text-center"&gt;
                &lt;MessageCircle className="w-24 h-24 text-gray-300 dark:text-slate-600 mx-auto mb-6" /&gt;
                &lt;h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white mb-2"&gt;Select a conversation&lt;/h2&gt;
                &lt;p className="text-gray-500 dark:text-slate-400 max-w-sm"&gt;
                  Choose from your recent chats or start a new conversation with your learning partners.
                &lt;/p&gt;
              &lt;/div&gt;
            &lt;/div&gt;
          )}
        &lt;/div&gt;
      &lt;/div&gt;
&nbsp;
      {/* Incoming Call Notification */}
      {showIncomingCall &amp;&amp; incomingCall &amp;&amp; (
        &lt;IncomingCallNotification
          callerName={incomingCall.callerName}
          callerAvatar={incomingCall.callerAvatar}
          isVideoCall={incomingCall.isVideoCall}
          onAccept={acceptIncomingCall}
          onDecline={declineIncomingCall}
        /&gt;
      )}
    &lt;/div&gt;
  );
} </pre></td></tr></table></pre>

// Comment form component
interface AddCommentFormProps {
  postId: string;
  onAddComment: (postId: string, comment: string) =&gt; void;
}
&nbsp;
function <span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >AddCommentForm({</span> postId, onAddComment }: AddCommentFormProps) {
  const { user } = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >useUser();</span>
  const [comment, setComment] = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >useState("");</span>
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >useState(false);</span>
&nbsp;
  const handleSubmit = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >async (e</span>: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    e.preventDefault();</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (!comment.trim() || isSubmitting) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >return;</span></span>
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    setIsSubmitting(true);</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    try {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      await onAddComment(postId, comment);</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      setComment("");</span>
    } finally {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      setIsSubmitting(false);</span>
    }
  };
&nbsp;
  const handleKeyPress = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >(e</span>: React.KeyboardEvent) =&gt; {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (e.key === 'Enter' &amp;&amp; !e.shiftKey) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      e.preventDefault();</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      handleSubmit(e);</span>
    }
  };
&nbsp;
  return (
    &lt;form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="w-full"&gt;
      &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-3"&gt;
        &lt;img
          src={user?.imageUrl || "https://i.pravatar.cc/150?img=12"}

            placeholder="Write a comment..."

            onChange={<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >(e</span>) =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >setComment(e.target.value)}</span>

          /&gt;
          {<span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >comment.trim() &amp;&amp; (</span>
            &lt;button
