&nbsp;
                    &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300"&gt;
                      &lt;Users className="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-400" /&gt;
                      &lt;span&gt;{group.currentParticipants} / {group.maxParticipants} participants&lt;/span&gt;
                    &lt;/div&gt;
                  &lt;/div&gt;
&nbsp;
                  {(group.meetingType === "in-person" || group.meetingType === "hybrid") &amp;&amp; group.location &amp;&amp; (
                    &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-4"&gt;
                      &lt;MapPin className="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-400" /&gt;
                      &lt;span&gt;{group.location}&lt;/span&gt;
                    &lt;/div&gt;
                  )}
&nbsp;
                  {<span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >group.tags.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; (</span>
                    &lt;div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 mt-4"&gt;
                      {group.tags.map(<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >(t</span>ag, index) =&gt; (
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >                        &lt;span</span>
                          key={index}
                          className="text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded-full bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300"
                        &gt;
                          #{tag}
                        &lt;/span&gt;
                      ))}
                    &lt;/div&gt;
                  )}
&nbsp;
                  &lt;div className="mt-4 pt-4 border-t border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 flex items-center justify-between"&gt;
                    &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-2"&gt;
                      &lt;img
                        src={group.organizer.avatar}
                        alt={group.organizer.name}
                        className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full object-cover"
                      /&gt;
                      &lt;div&gt;
                        &lt;p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-white"&gt;
                          {group.organizer.name}
                        &lt;/p&gt;
                        &lt;p className="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400"&gt;
                          Organizer
                        &lt;/p&gt;
                      &lt;/div&gt;
                    &lt;/div&gt;
&nbsp;
                    {<span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >group.joined </span>&amp;&amp; (
                      &lt;Button
                        size="sm"
                        variant="ghost"
                        className="text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-400"
                        onClick={<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >() =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >r</span>outer.push(`/group-study/chat/${group.id}`)}</span>
                      &gt;
                        &lt;MessageSquare className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" /&gt; Group Chat
                      &lt;/Button&gt;
                    )}
                  &lt;/div&gt;
                &lt;/div&gt;
              &lt;/div&gt;
              ))}
            &lt;/div&gt;
          ) : (
            &lt;div className="text-center py-12 bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-xl shadow-md"&gt;
              &lt;Users className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto text-gray-400 dark:text-gray-600 mb-4" /&gt;
              &lt;h3 className="text-xl font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-white mb-2"&gt;
                No study groups found
              &lt;/h3&gt;
              &lt;p className="text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 mb-6"&gt;
                Try adjusting your search or filter criteria, or create your own study group!
              &lt;/p&gt;
              &lt;Button
                onClick={<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >() =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >s</span>etShowCreateForm(true)}</span>
                className="bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-500 to-blue-600 hover:from-cyan-600 hover:to-blue-700"
              &gt;
                &lt;Plus className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" /&gt; Create New Study Group
              &lt;/Button&gt;
            &lt;/div&gt;
          )}
        &lt;/div&gt;
      &lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;/&gt;
  );
} </pre></td></tr></table></pre>

                {post.pollOptions.reduce(<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >(s</span>um, _, optionIndex) =&gt; {

    const type = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >searchParams.get('type'); /</span>/ 'my-groups', 'active-groups'

<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (!dbUser.length) {</span>

export async function <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >GET(</span></span>
  request: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise&lt;{ threadId: string }&gt; }
) {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  try {</span>
    const { threadId } = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await params;</span>
&nbsp;
    // Fetch comments with user information using raw SQL
    const result = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await db.execute(sql`</span>
      SELECT 
        c.comment_id,
        c.content,
        c.timestamp,

        c.sender_id,
        u.full_name,
        u.avatar_url

    `);

    const comments = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >result.rows || [];</span>

&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return {</span>
        id: comment.comment_id,
        author: authorName,
        authorImage: comment.avatar_url || 'https://i.pravatar.cc/150?img=12',

  } catch (error) {

// Helper function to calculate time ago
function <span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >getTimeAgo(d</span>ate: Date | string): string {
  const now = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >new Date();</span>
&nbsp;
  // Handle string input from database
  let targetDate: Date;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  if (typeof date === 'string') {</span>
    // If the date string doesn't end with 'Z', treat it as local time
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (!date.endsWith('Z') &amp;&amp; !date.includes('+')) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      targetDate = new Date(date + 'Z'); /</span>/ Treat as UTC
    } else {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      targetDate = new Date(date);</span>
    }
  } else {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    targetDate = date;</span>
  }
&nbsp;
  // Ensure we have valid dates
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (!(targetDate instanceof Date) || isNaN(targetDate.getTime())) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return 'Just now';</span>
  }
&nbsp;
  // Simple direct comparison without timezone conversion
  const diffInMs = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >now.getTime() - targetDate.getTime();</span>
  const diffInSeconds = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >Math.floor(diffInMs / 1000);</span>
&nbsp;
  // Handle future dates (in case of timezone issues)
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (diffInSeconds &lt; 0) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return 'Just now';</span>
  }
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  if (diffInSeconds &lt; 60) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return 'Just now';</span>
  } else <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >if (diffInSeconds &lt; 3600) {</span>
    const minutes = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >Math.floor(diffInSeconds / 60);</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return `${minutes}m ago`;</span>
  } else <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >if (diffInSeconds &lt; 86400) {</span>
    const hours = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >Math.floor(diffInSeconds / 3600);</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return `${hours}h ago`;</span>
  } else <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >if (diffInSeconds &lt; 604800) { // 7 days</span>
    const days = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >Math.floor(diffInSeconds / 86400);</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return `${days}d ago`;</span>
  } else <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >if (diffInSeconds &lt; 2592000) { // 30 days</span>
    const weeks = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >Math.floor(diffInSeconds / 604800);</span>

// GET /api/community/threads-drizzle - Fetch threads using Drizzle ORM
export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
    const page = parseInt(searchParams.get('page') || '1');
    const limit = parseInt(searchParams.get('limit') || '10');
    const sortBy = (searchParams.get('sortBy') || 'recent') as 'recent' | 'popular' | 'mostComments';
    const search = searchParams.get('search') || undefined;
&nbsp;
    if (isNaN(page) || isNaN(limit) || page &lt; 1 || limit &lt; 1) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error: 'Invalid pagination parameters',
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }
&nbsp;
    const offset = (page - 1) * limit;
&nbsp;
    // Fetch threads using Drizzle helper
    const [threads, totalCount] = await Promise.all([
      getThreads({ limit, offset, sortBy, search }),
      getThreadCount(search)
    ]);
&nbsp;
    console.log(`✅ Fetched ${threads.length} threads using Drizzle ORM`);
&nbsp;
    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      data: {
        threads,
        pagination: {
          page,
          limit,
          total: totalCount,
          totalPages: Math.ceil(totalCount / limit),
        },
      },
    });
&nbsp;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('❌ Drizzle API Error:', error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error: 'Failed to fetch threads',
        details: error instanceof Error ? error.message : <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >'Unknown error'</span>
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}
&nbsp;
// POST /api/community/threads-drizzle - Create new thread using Drizzle ORM
export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const { userId } = await auth();

// Helper function to calculate time ago

&nbsp;
export async function <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >GET(r</span></span>equest: NextRequest) {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  try {</span>
    const { searchParams } = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >new URL(request.url);</span>
    const query = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >searchParams.get('q') || '';</span>
    const limit = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >parseInt(searchParams.get('limit') || '10');</span>
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (!query.trim()) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return NextResponse.json({ users: [] });</span>

    const searchPattern = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >`%${query}%`;</span>
&nbsp;
    const users = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await db</span>
      .select({
        userId: usersTable.userId,
        fullName: usersTable.fullName,
        avatarUrl: usersTable.avatarUrl,

        grade: userProfilesTable.grade,
        school: userProfilesTable.school,
        country: userProfilesTable.country,
      })
      .from(usersTable)
      .leftJoin(userProfilesTable, eq(usersTable.userId, userProfilesTable.userId))
      .where(

      bio: user.bio || '',
      grade: user.grade || '',
      school: user.school || '',
      country: user.country || '',
      isOnline: user.lastActiveAt ?
        (new Date().getTime() - new Date(user.lastActiveAt).getTime()) &lt; 30 * 60 * 1000 : false,
    }));

    url: string;
  };

  role: string;
  content: string | MessageContent[];

// Expects a JSON body: { messages: { role: "user" | "assistant" | "system", content: string }[] }
// Returns: { reply: string }
//

  name: string;
  type: string;
  data: string; // base64 encoded (no data: prefix)
}

// GET - Fetch user's doubt-solving sessions
export async function <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >GET(</span></span>request: NextRequest) {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  try {</span>
    const { userId } = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await auth();</span>
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (!userId) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return NextResponse.json(</span>
        { error: 'Unauthorized - Please log in to view sessions' },
        { status: 401 }
      );
    }
&nbsp;
    // Ensure user exists in database
    const syncResult = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await syncUserToDatabase();</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (!syncResult.success) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      console.warn('User sync failed:', syncResult.message);</span>
    }
&nbsp;
    // Get user's database ID using correct column names
    const userResult = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await db.execute(sql`</span>
      SELECT "user_id" FROM users WHERE "clerk_id" = ${userId} LIMIT 1
    `);
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (!userResult.rows || userResult.rows.length === 0) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return NextResponse.json(</span>
        { error: 'User not found in database' },
        { status: 404 }
      );
    }
&nbsp;
    const userDbId = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >userResult.rows[0].user_id;</span>
&nbsp;
    // Fetch sessions with message count

        s.session_id,

        s.subject_id,
        s.topic_id,
        s.message_count,
        s.last_message_at,
        s.is_archived,
        s.created_at,
        s.updated_at,
        COUNT(m.message_id) as actual_message_count
      FROM doubt_solving_sessions s
      LEFT JOIN doubt_solving_messages m ON s.session_id = m.session_id
      WHERE s.user_id = ${userDbId}
      GROUP BY s.session_id, s.title, s.subject_id, s.topic_id, s.message_count, s.last_message_at, s.is_archived, s.created_at, s.updated_at
      ORDER BY s.last_message_at DESC
    `);

      title: session.title,
      subjectId: session.subject_id,

      lastMessageDate: new Date(session.last_message_at),

// GET - Fetch specific session details
export async function <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >GET(</span></span>
  request: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise&lt;{ sessionId: string }&gt; }
) {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  try {</span>
    const { userId } = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await auth();</span>
    const { sessionId } = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await params;</span>
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (!userId) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return NextResponse.json(</span>
        { error: 'Unauthorized - Please log in to view session' },
        { status: 401 }
      );
    }
&nbsp;
    // Ensure user exists in database
    const syncResult = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await syncUserToDatabase();</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (!syncResult.success) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      console.warn('User sync failed:', syncResult.message);</span>
    }
&nbsp;
    // Get user's database ID using correct column names
    const userResult = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await db.execute(sql`</span>
      SELECT "user_id" FROM users WHERE "clerk_id" = ${userId} LIMIT 1
    `);
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (!userResult.rows || userResult.rows.length === 0) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return NextResponse.json(</span>
        { error: 'User not found in database' },
        { status: 404 }
      );
    }
&nbsp;
    const userDbId = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >userResult.rows[0].user_id;</span>
&nbsp;
    // Fetch session details
    const sessionResult = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await db.execute(sql`</span>
      SELECT 
        s.session_id,
        s.title,
        s.subject_id,
        s.topic_id,
        s.message_count,
        s.last_message_at,
        s.is_archived,
        s.created_at,
        s.updated_at,
        COUNT(m.message_id) as actual_message_count
      FROM doubt_solving_sessions s
      LEFT JOIN doubt_solving_messages m ON s.session_id = m.session_id
      WHERE s.session_id = ${sessionId} AND s.user_id = ${userDbId}
      GROUP BY s.session_id, s.title, s.subject_id, s.topic_id, s.message_count, s.last_message_at, s.is_archived, s.created_at, s.updated_at
    `);

<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return NextResponse.json(</span>
        { error: 'Session not found or access denied' },
        { status: 404 }
      );
    }
&nbsp;
    const session = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >sessionResult.rows[0];</span>
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return NextResponse.json({</span>
      session: {
        id: session.session_id,
        title: session.title,
        subjectId: session.subject_id,
        topicId: session.topic_id,
        messageCount: session.actual_message_count || 0,
        lastMessageDate: new Date(session.last_message_at),
        isArchived: session.is_archived,
        createdAt: session.created_at,
        updatedAt: session.updated_at,
      }
    });
&nbsp;
  } catch (error) {

<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return NextResponse.json(</span>
      { error: 'Failed to fetch session' },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

<span class="cline-any cline-neutral">&nbsp;</span></td><td class="text"><pre class="prettyprint lang-js">import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >'next/server';</span>
import { db } from <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >'@/db';</span>
import { doubtSolvingSessionsTable, doubtSolvingMessagesTable } from '@/db/schema';
import { sql } from <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >'drizzle-orm';</span>
import { auth } from <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >'@clerk/nextjs/server';</span>
import { syncUserToDatabase } from <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >'@/lib/user-sync';</span>
&nbsp;
// GET - Fetch messages for a specific session
export async function <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >GET(</span></span>
  request: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise&lt;{ sessionId: string }&gt; }
) {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  try {</span>
    const { userId } = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await auth();</span>
    const { sessionId } = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await params;</span>
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (!userId) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return NextResponse.json(</span>
        { error: 'Unauthorized - Please log in to view messages' },
        { status: 401 }
      );
    }
&nbsp;
    // Ensure user exists in database
    const syncResult = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await syncUserToDatabase();</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (!syncResult.success) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      console.warn('User sync failed:', syncResult.message);</span>
    }
&nbsp;
    // Get user's database ID using correct column names
    const userResult = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await db.execute(sql`</span>
      SELECT "user_id" FROM users WHERE "clerk_id" = ${userId} LIMIT 1
    `);
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (!userResult.rows || userResult.rows.length === 0) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return NextResponse.json(</span>
        { error: 'User not found in database' },
        { status: 404 }
      );
    }
&nbsp;
    const userDbId = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >userResult.rows[0].user_id;</span>
&nbsp;
    // Verify session belongs to user
    const sessionResult = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await db.execute(sql`</span>
      SELECT session_id FROM doubt_solving_sessions 
      WHERE session_id = ${sessionId} AND user_id = ${userDbId}
      LIMIT 1
    `);
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (!sessionResult.rows || sessionResult.rows.length === 0) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return NextResponse.json(</span>
        { error: 'Session not found or access denied' },
        { status: 404 }
      );
    }
&nbsp;
    // Fetch messages for the session
    const messagesResult = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await db.execute(sql`</span>
      SELECT 
        message_id,
        role,
        content,
        attachment_url,
        attachment_type,
        attachment_name,
        token_count,
        processing_time,
        model_used,
        metadata,
        created_at
      FROM doubt_solving_messages
      WHERE session_id = ${sessionId}
      ORDER BY created_at ASC
    `);
&nbsp;
    const messages = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >messagesResult.rows.map(<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >(m</span>essage: any) =&gt; (<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >{</span></span>
      id: message.message_id,
      role: message.role,
      content: message.content,
      attachmentUrl: message.attachment_url,
      attachmentType: message.attachment_type,
      attachmentName: message.attachment_name,
      tokenCount: message.token_count,
      processingTime: message.processing_time,
      modelUsed: message.model_used,
      metadata: message.metadata,
      timestamp: new Date(message.created_at),
    }));
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return NextResponse.json({ messages });</span>

      )}
&nbsp;
      {/* Learning Partners (Following) */}
      {loading ? (
        &lt;div className="text-center py-6"&gt;
          &lt;div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-6 w-6 border-2 border-blue-500 border-t-transparent mx-auto"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
        &lt;/div&gt;
      ) : followingUsers.length &gt; 0 ? (
        &lt;div className="space-y-2"&gt;
          &lt;p className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-medium"&gt;Learning Partners&lt;/p&gt;
          {followingUsers.map((user) =&gt; (
            &lt;div
              key={user.userId}
              className="flex items-center gap-3 p-2 hover:bg-slate-800/30 rounded-lg transition-colors group"
            &gt;
              &lt;img
                src={user.avatarUrl || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >"https://i.pravatar.cc/150?img=1"}</span>
                alt={user.fullName}
                className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full"
              /&gt;
              &lt;div className="flex-1 min-w-0"&gt;
                &lt;p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-100 truncate"&gt;{user.fullName}&lt;/p&gt;
                &lt;p className="text-xs text-slate-500"&gt;Active learning partner&lt;/p&gt;
              &lt;/div&gt;
              &lt;div className="flex gap-1 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity"&gt;
                &lt;button
                  onClick={() =&gt; router.push(`/chat?with=${user.userId}`)}
                  className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-blue-400 rounded transition-colors"
                  title="Start chat"
                &gt;
                  &lt;Send className="w-3 h-3" /&gt;
                &lt;/button&gt;
                &lt;button
                  onClick={() =&gt; visitProfile(user.userId)}
                  className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-purple-400 rounded transition-colors"
                  title="Visit profile"
                &gt;
                  &lt;User className="w-3 h-3" /&gt;
                &lt;/button&gt;
              &lt;/div&gt;
            &lt;/div&gt;
          ))}
        &lt;/div&gt;
      ) : (
        &lt;div className="text-center py-6"&gt;
          &lt;User className="w-8 h-8 text-slate-400 mx-auto mb-2" /&gt;
          &lt;p className="text-sm text-slate-400"&gt;No learning partners yet&lt;/p&gt;
          &lt;p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1"&gt;Follow users to see them here&lt;/p&gt;
        &lt;/div&gt;
      )}
&nbsp;
      {/* Recent Conversations */}
      {recentChats.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; (
        &lt;div className="space-y-2 pt-4 border-t border-slate-700/30"&gt;
          &lt;p className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-medium"&gt;Recent Conversations&lt;/p&gt;
          {recentChats.slice(0, 3).map((chat) =&gt; (
            &lt;div
              key={chat.userId}
              onClick={<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >() =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >r</span>outer.push(`/chat?with=${chat.userId}`)}</span>
              className="flex items-start gap-3 p-2 hover:bg-slate-800/30 rounded-lg cursor-pointer transition-colors group"
            &gt;
              &lt;img
                src={chat.avatarUrl || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >"https://i.pravatar.cc/150?img=1"}</span>
                alt={chat.fullName}
                className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full"
              /&gt;
              &lt;div className="flex-1 min-w-0"&gt;
                &lt;div className="flex items-center justify-between"&gt;
                  &lt;p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-100 truncate"&gt;{chat.fullName}&lt;/p&gt;
                  {chat.lastMessageTime &amp;&amp; (
                    &lt;p className="text-xs text-slate-500"&gt;{formatTime(chat.lastMessageTime)}&lt;/p&gt;
                  )}
                &lt;/div&gt;
                {chat.lastMessage &amp;&amp; (
                  &lt;p className="text-xs text-slate-500 truncate"&gt;{chat.lastMessage}&lt;/p&gt;
                )}
              &lt;/div&gt;
              {!chat.isRead &amp;&amp; (
                &lt;div className="w-2 h-2 bg-blue-500 rounded-full mt-2"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
              )}
            &lt;/div&gt;
          ))}
        &lt;/div&gt;
      )}
    &lt;/div&gt;
  );
} </pre></td></tr></table></pre>

interface StudyGroup {
  groupId: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  meetingType: string;
  nextMeeting: string;
  meetingTime: string;
  currentParticipants: number;
  maxParticipants: number;
  subjectName: string;
  subjectColor: string;
  creatorName: string;
  creatorAvatar: string;
  memberRole: string;
  joinedAt: string;
}
&nbsp;
export default function MyStudyGroups() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [myGroups, setMyGroups] = useState&lt;StudyGroup[]&gt;([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
&nbsp;
  useEffect(() =&gt; {
    fetchMyGroups();
  }, []);
&nbsp;
  const fetchMyGroups = async () =&gt; {
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/community/study-groups?type=my-groups');
      if (response.ok) {
        const data = await response.json();
        setMyGroups(data.groups || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >[])</span>;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching my study groups:', error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };
&nbsp;
  const handleGroupClick = (groupId: string) =&gt; {
    router.push(`/group-study/chat/${groupId}`);
  };
&nbsp;
  const formatDate = (dateString: string) =&gt; {
    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (!dateString) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >return 'TBD';</span>
    const date = new Date(dateString);
    return date.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
      month: 'short',
      day: 'numeric',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit'
    });
  };
&nbsp;
  const getSubjectInitial = (subjectName: string) =&gt; {
    return subjectName ? subjectName.charAt(0).toUpperCase() : <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >'S';</span>
  };
&nbsp;
  const getSubjectColor = (color: string) =&gt; {
    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (color &amp;&amp; color.startsWith('#')) {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return `bg-[${color}]`;</span>
    }
    // Fallback colors
    const colors = [
      'bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-500 to-purple-600',
      'bg-gradient-to-r from-red-500 to-pink-600',
      'bg-gradient-to-r from-yellow-500 to-orange-600',
      'bg-gradient-to-r from-green-500 to-emerald-600',
      'bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-500 to-indigo-600',
    ];
    return colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)];
  };
&nbsp;
  if (loading) {
    return (
      &lt;div className="text-center py-6"&gt;
        &lt;div data-testid="loading-spinner" className="animate-spin rounded-full h-6 w-6 border-2 border-emerald-500 border-t-transparent mx-auto"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
      &lt;/div&gt;
    );
  }
&nbsp;
  if (myGroups.length === 0) {
    return (
      &lt;div className="text-center py-6"&gt;
        &lt;Users className="w-8 h-8 text-slate-400 mx-auto mb-2" /&gt;
        &lt;p className="text-sm text-slate-400"&gt;No study groups yet&lt;/p&gt;
        &lt;p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1"&gt;Join some groups to see them here&lt;/p&gt;

          className="mt-3 px-4 py-2 bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-600 text-white rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-colors"
        &gt;
          Browse Groups
        &lt;/button&gt;
      &lt;/div&gt;
    );
  }
&nbsp;
  return (
    &lt;div className="space-y-3"&gt;
      {myGroups.map((group) =&gt; (
        &lt;div
          key={group.groupId}
          onClick={() =&gt; handleGroupClick(group.groupId)}
          className="p-3 bg-slate-800/30 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-800/50 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        &gt;
          &lt;div className="flex items-start gap-3"&gt;
            &lt;div className={`w-10 h-10 ${getSubjectColor(group.subjectColor)} rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-white font-bold flex-shrink-0`}&gt;
              {getSubjectInitial(group.subjectName)}
            &lt;/div&gt;
            &lt;div className="flex-1 min-w-0"&gt;
              &lt;div className="flex items-start justify-between"&gt;
                &lt;div className="flex-1 min-w-0"&gt;
                  &lt;h4 className="font-semibold text-slate-100 text-sm truncate"&gt;{group.name}&lt;/h4&gt;
                  &lt;p className="text-xs text-slate-500"&gt;{group.subjectName}&lt;/p&gt;
                &lt;/div&gt;
                &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-slate-400 ml-2"&gt;
                  &lt;div className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${group.meetingType === 'online' ? 'bg-green-500' :
                      group.meetingType === 'in-person' ? 'bg-blue-500' : <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >'bg-purple-500'</span>

                &lt;/div&gt;

&nbsp;
              &lt;div className="mt-2 space-y-1"&gt;

&nbsp;
import { useAuth } from "@clerk/nextjs";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useEffect, useState, ReactNode } from "react";
import { Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
&nbsp;
interface AuthCheckProps {
  children: ReactNode;
  fallback?: ReactNode;
  loadingComponent?: ReactNode;
}
&nbsp;
export default function AuthCheck({
  children,
  fallback,
  loadingComponent
}: AuthCheckProps) {
  const { isLoaded, isSignedIn } = useAuth();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [isChecking, setIsChecking] = useState(true);
&nbsp;
  useEffect(() =&gt; {
    if (isLoaded) {
      setIsChecking(false);
      if (!isSignedIn &amp;&amp; !fallback) {
        // If no fallback is provided, redirect to sign-in
        router.push("/custom-auth/sign-in");
      }
    }
  }, [isLoaded, isSignedIn, router, fallback]);
&nbsp;
  if (!isLoaded || isChecking) {
    // Show loading state while checking auth
    return (
      loadingComponent || (
        &lt;div className="flex justify-center items-center min-h-screen"&gt;
          &lt;Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-400" /&gt;
          &lt;span className="ml-2 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300"&gt;Checking authentication...&lt;/span&gt;
        &lt;/div&gt;
      )
    );
  }
&nbsp;
  // If signed in, show the protected content
  if (isSignedIn) {
    return &lt;&gt;{children}&lt;/&gt;;
  }
&nbsp;
  // If not signed in and fallback is provided, show the fallback
  if (fallback) {
    return &lt;&gt;{fallback}&lt;/&gt;;
  }
&nbsp;
  // This should not be reached if there's a redirect in the useEffect
  return null;
} </pre></td></tr></table></pre>

import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import AgoraRTC, {
  IAgoraRTCRemoteUser,
  IMicrophoneAudioTrack
} from 'agora-rtc-sdk-ng';
import {
  Mic,
  MicOff,
  PhoneOff,
  Volume2,
  VolumeX,
  User
} from 'lucide-react';
&nbsp;
interface AudioCallProps {
  channelName: string;
  userId: string;
  onCallEnd: () =&gt; void;
  appId: string;
  token?: string;
  recipientName?: string;
}
&nbsp;
export default function AudioCall({
  channelName,
  userId,
  onCallEnd,
  appId,
  token,
  recipientName

  // Using 'vp8' (default) for pure-audio calls to avoid unsupported 'opus' error.
  const [client] = useState(() =&gt; AgoraRTC.createClient({ mode: 'rtc', codec: 'vp8' }));
  const [localAudioTrack, setLocalAudioTrack] = useState&lt;IMicrophoneAudioTrack | null&gt;(null);
  const [remoteUsers, setRemoteUsers] = useState&lt;IAgoraRTCRemoteUser[]&gt;([]);
&nbsp;
  const [isAudioEnabled, setIsAudioEnabled] = useState(true);
  const [isSpeakerEnabled, setIsSpeakerEnabled] = useState(true);
  const [isJoined, setIsJoined] = useState(false);
  const [isConnecting, setIsConnecting] = useState(false);
  const [callDuration, setCallDuration] = useState(0);
  const [connectionError, setConnectionError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);
&nbsp;
  const connectLockRef = useRef(false);
&nbsp;
  useEffect(() =&gt; {
    const init = async () =&gt; {

      setIsConnecting(true);
      setConnectionError(null);

      // Validate App ID format (should be 32 characters, alphanumeric)

        setConnectionError('Invalid Agora App ID format. App ID should be exactly 32 alphanumeric characters.');
        setIsConnecting(false);
        connectLockRef.current = false;
        return;
      }
&nbsp;
      try {

        <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (client.connectionState === 'CONNECTED' || client.connectionState === 'CONNECTING') {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          console.log('Audio client already connected/connecting, leaving first...');</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          await client.leave();</span>
        }

        client.on('user-published', handleUserPublished);

        console.log('Creating audio track...');
        const audioTrack = await AgoraRTC.createMicrophoneAudioTrack();
        setLocalAudioTrack(audioTrack);
&nbsp;
        // Fetch token if not provided (App Certificate enabled)
        let finalToken = token || null;
        let finalUid: string | null | undefined = userId;
&nbsp;
        if (!finalToken) {
          try {
            const tokenResponse = await fetch('/api/agora-token', {
              method: 'POST',
              headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
              body: JSON.stringify({ channelName, role: 'host' })
            });
&nbsp;
            <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (!tokenResponse.ok) {
              const errData = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await tokenResponse.json();</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >              throw new Error(errData.error || 'Failed to fetch token');</span>
            }
&nbsp;
            const tokenData = await tokenResponse.json();
            finalToken = tokenData.token;
            finalUid = tokenData.uid;
            console.log('Audio token received, expires at:', tokenData.expiresAt);
          } catch (tokenErr: any) {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            console.error('Audio token generation failed:', tokenErr);</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            setConnectionError('Failed to obtain Agora token. ' + (tokenErr.message || ''));</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            setIsConnecting(false);</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            connectLockRef.current = false;</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            await cleanup();</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            return;</span>
          }
        }
&nbsp;
        // Prevent duplicate join attempts if SDK still thinks it is busy
        <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (client.connectionState !== 'DISCONNECTED') {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          console.warn('Audio client is not in DISCONNECTED state, current:', client.connectionState);</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          return;</span>
        }
&nbsp;
        console.log('Joining audio channel:', channelName);
        await client.join(appId, channelName, finalToken, finalUid);
        console.log('Successfully joined audio channel');
&nbsp;
        await client.publish(audioTrack);
        console.log('Successfully published audio track');
&nbsp;
        setIsJoined(true);
        setIsConnecting(false);
      } catch (error: any) {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        console.error('Failed to join audio call:', error);</span>
&nbsp;
        let errorMessage = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >'Failed to join audio call. ';</span>
        let actionMessage = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >'';</span>
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        if (error.code === 'CAN_NOT_GET_GATEWAY_SERVER') {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          errorMessage += 'Gateway server error - this usually means the App ID is invalid or requires a token.';</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          actionMessage = 'Solutions:\n• Verify your Agora App ID is correct\n• Create a new App ID from Agora Console\n• For production, implement token authentication\n• Try using a different App ID';</span>
        } else <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >if (error.code === 'INVALID_PARAMS') {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          errorMessage += 'Invalid parameters. Please check the channel name and App ID.';</span>

<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          errorMessage += 'This App ID requires token authentication.';</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          actionMessage = 'Solutions:\n• Use a different App ID without App Certificate enabled\n• Implement token server for production\n• Check Agora Console project settings';</span>
        } else {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          errorMessage += error.message || 'Unknown error occurred.';</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          actionMessage = 'Check browser console for more details.';</span>
        }
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        setConnectionError(errorMessage + (actionMessage ? '\n\n' + actionMessage : ''));</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        setIsConnecting(false);</span>
&nbsp;
        // Clean up on error
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        await cleanup();</span>

        // If not connected, release lock so another attempt can happen

          connectLockRef.current = false;
        }

    init();
&nbsp;
    return () =&gt; {
      cleanup();
    };
  }, [channelName, userId, appId]);
&nbsp;
  // Call duration timer
  useEffect(() =&gt; {
    let interval: NodeJS.Timeout;
&nbsp;
    if (isJoined) {
      interval = setInterval(<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >() =&gt; {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        setCallDuration(<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >prev =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >p</span>rev + 1);</span></span>
      }, 1000);
    }
&nbsp;
    return () =&gt; {
      if (interval) clearInterval(interval);
    };
  }, [isJoined]);
&nbsp;
  const handleUserPublished = <span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >async (u</span>ser: IAgoraRTCRemoteUser, mediaType: 'audio') =&gt; {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    await client.subscribe(user, mediaType);</span>
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (mediaType === 'audio' &amp;&amp; user.audioTrack) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      user.audioTrack.play();</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      setRemoteUsers(<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >prev =&gt; {</span></span>
        const existing = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >prev.find(<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >u =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >u</span>.uid === user.uid)</span>;</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (!existing) {</span>

        }

      });
    }
  };
&nbsp;
  const handleUserUnpublished = <span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >(u</span>ser: IAgoraRTCRemoteUser) =&gt; {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    setRemoteUsers(<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >prev =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >p</span>rev.filter(<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >u =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >u</span>.uid !== user.uid)</span>);</span></span>

&nbsp;
  const handleUserLeft = <span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >(u</span>ser: IAgoraRTCRemoteUser) =&gt; {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    setRemoteUsers(<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >prev =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >p</span>rev.filter(<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >u =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >u</span>.uid !== user.uid)</span>);</span></span>
  };
&nbsp;
  const toggleAudio = async () =&gt; {
    if (localAudioTrack) {

      setIsAudioEnabled(!isAudioEnabled);
    }
  };
&nbsp;
  const toggleSpeaker = () =&gt; {
    setIsSpeakerEnabled(!isSpeakerEnabled);
    // Note: Agora handles speaker/earpiece switching automatically
    // This is more for UI feedback
  };
&nbsp;
  const cleanup = async () =&gt; {

      if (localAudioTrack) {

  const formatDuration = (seconds: number) =&gt; {

          &lt;div className="flex justify-center items-center gap-4 mt-6"&gt;
            {remoteUsers.map(<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >(u</span>ser) =&gt; (

        &lt;/div&gt;

&nbsp;
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Phone, PhoneOff, Video, VideoOff } from 'lucide-react';
&nbsp;
interface IncomingCallNotificationProps {
  callerName: string;
  callerAvatar?: string;
  isVideoCall: boolean;
  onAccept: () =&gt; void;
  onDecline: () =&gt; void;
  onShow?: () =&gt; void;
}
&nbsp;
export default function IncomingCallNotification({
  callerName,
  callerAvatar,
  isVideoCall,
  onAccept,
  onDecline,
  onShow
}: IncomingCallNotificationProps) {
  const [isVisible, setIsVisible] = useState(false);
  const [isRinging, setIsRinging] = useState(false);
&nbsp;
  console.log('🔔 IncomingCallNotification component mounted with props:', {
    callerName,
    callerAvatar,
    isVideoCall
  });
&nbsp;
  useEffect(() =&gt; {
    console.log('🚀 IncomingCallNotification useEffect - showing notification');
    // Show notification with animation
    setIsVisible(true);
    setIsRinging(true);
    onShow?.();
&nbsp;
    // Auto-decline after 30 seconds
    const autoDeclineTimer = setTimeout(() =&gt; {
      console.log('⏰ Auto-declining call after 30 seconds');
      handleDecline();
    }, 30000);
&nbsp;
    return () =&gt; {
      clearTimeout(autoDeclineTimer);
      setIsRinging(false);
    };
  }, []);
&nbsp;
  const handleAccept = () =&gt; {
    console.log('✅ Call accepted');
    setIsRinging(false);
    setIsVisible(false);
    onAccept();
  };
&nbsp;
  const handleDecline = () =&gt; {
    console.log('❌ Call declined');
    setIsRinging(false);
    setIsVisible(false);
    onDecline();
  };
&nbsp;
  if (!isVisible) {
    console.log('👻 Notification not visible, returning null');
    return null;
  }
&nbsp;
  console.log('🎨 Rendering notification popup');
&nbsp;
  return (
    &lt;&gt;
      {/* Backdrop */}
      &lt;div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm z-[100]" /&gt;
&nbsp;
      {/* Notification */}
      &lt;div className="fixed inset-0 flex items-center justify-center z-[101] p-4"&gt;
        &lt;div

                  src={callerAvatar || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >'/api/placeholder/96/96'}</span>

                /&gt;
              &lt;/div&gt;

              )}

              title="Decline call"
            &gt;

            &lt;/button&gt;
&nbsp;

const FeatureCarousel = () =&gt; {
  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(0);
  const carouselRef = useRef&lt;HTMLDivElement&gt;(null);
  const [visibleCards, setVisibleCards] = useState(1);
  const totalFeatures = FEATURES.length;
&nbsp;
  // Determine visible cards based on screen width
  useEffect(() =&gt; {
    const handleResize = () =&gt; {
      const width = window.innerWidth;
      console.log("Width:", width); // Debugging line

        // medium-small screens - 2 cards{
        // medium screens - 2 cards
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        setVisibleCards(2);</span>
      } else {
        // small screens - 1 card
        setVisibleCards(1);
      }
    };
&nbsp;
    handleResize(); // Initial check
    window.addEventListener("resize", handleResize);
    return () =&gt; window.removeEventListener("resize", handleResize);
  }, []);
&nbsp;
  const handleNext = <span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >() =&gt; {</span>
    // Only increment if we haven't reached the end
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (activeIndex + visibleCards &lt; totalFeatures) {</span>

    } else {
      // Loop back to the beginning

  const handlePrev = <span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >() =&gt; {</span>

export const useFileUpload = (): UseFileUploadReturn =&gt; {
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0);
  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);
  const [uploadedFile, setUploadedFile] = useState&lt;UploadedFile | null&gt;(null);
&nbsp;
  const uploadFile = async (file: File): Promise&lt;UploadedFile | null&gt; =&gt; {
    setUploading(true);
    setProgress(0);
    setError(null);
&nbsp;
    try {
      // Validate file size
      const maxSize = 10 * 1024 * 1024; // 10MB
      <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (file.size &gt; maxSize) {

      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append('file', file);
&nbsp;
      // Upload file using fetch with progress tracking
      const response = await fetch('/api/upload', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: formData,
      });
&nbsp;
      if (!response.ok) {
        const errorData = await response.json();
        throw new Error(errorData.error || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >'Upload failed');</span>
      }
&nbsp;
      const result = await response.json();
&nbsp;
      if (result.success) {
        setUploadedFile(result.file);
        setProgress(100);
        return result.file;
      } else <span class="missing-if-branch" title="else path not taken" >E</span>{
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        throw new Error(result.error || 'Upload failed');</span>

      setError(err.message);
      return null;

import {

  chatsTable,
  messagesTable
} from '@/db/schema';
import { eq, desc, asc, count, and, or, ilike, sql } from 'drizzle-orm';

// User Operations
export async function findUserByClerkId(clerkId: string) {
  const users = await db
    .select()
    .from(usersTable)
    .where(eq(usersTable.clerkId, clerkId))
    .limit(1);
&nbsp;
  return users[0] || null;
}
&nbsp;
export async function findUserByEmail(email: string) {
  const users = await db
    .select()
    .from(usersTable)
    .where(eq(usersTable.email, email))
    .limit(1);
&nbsp;
  return users[0] || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >null;</span>
}
&nbsp;
export async function createUser(userData: {
  clerkId?: string;
  fullName: string;
  email: string;
  role?: 'student' | 'teacher' | 'admin';
}) {
  const newUsers = await db
    .insert(usersTable)
    .values({
      clerkId: userData.clerkId,
      fullName: userData.fullName,
      email: userData.email,
      role: userData.role || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >'student',</span>
    })
    .returning();
&nbsp;
  return newUsers[0];
}
&nbsp;
export async function updateUser(userId: string, updates: Partial&lt;{
  fullName: string;
  email: string;
  lastActiveAt: Date;
  avatarUrl: string;
  isLocked: boolean;
}&gt;) {
  const updatedUsers = await db
    .update(usersTable)
    .set({
      ...updates,
      // Always update the timestamp when updating user
      lastActiveAt: new Date(),
    })
    .where(eq(usersTable.userId, userId))
    .returning();
&nbsp;
  return updatedUsers[0] || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >null;</span>
}
&nbsp;
// Thread Operations
export async function getThreads(options: {
  limit?: number;
  offset?: number;
  sortBy?: 'recent' | 'popular' | 'mostComments';
  search?: string;
}) {
  const { limit = 10, offset = 0, sortBy = 'recent', search } = options;
&nbsp;
  let query = db
    .select({
      threadId: threadsTable.threadId,
      title: threadsTable.title,
      body: threadsTable.body,
      createdBy: threadsTable.createdBy,
      createdAt: threadsTable.createdAt,
      updatedAt: threadsTable.updatedAt,
      likeCount: threadsTable.likeCount,
      commentCount: threadsTable.commentCount,
      viewCount: threadsTable.viewCount,
      isPinned: threadsTable.isPinned,
      isLocked: threadsTable.isLocked,
    })
    .from(threadsTable);
&nbsp;
  // Add search filter if provided
  if (search) {
    query = query.where(
      or(
        ilike(threadsTable.title, `%${search}%`),
        ilike(threadsTable.body, `%${search}%`)
      )
    );
  }
&nbsp;
  // Add sorting
  switch (sortBy) {
<span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >    case 'popular':</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      query = query.orderBy(desc(threadsTable.likeCount));</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      break;</span>
<span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >    case 'mostComments':</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      query = query.orderBy(desc(threadsTable.commentCount));</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      break;</span>
    default:
      query = query.orderBy(desc(threadsTable.createdAt));
  }
&nbsp;
  // Add pagination
  query = query.limit(limit).offset(offset);
&nbsp;
  return await query;
}
&nbsp;
export async function getThreadCount(search?: string) {
  let query = db
    .select({ count: count() })
    .from(threadsTable);
&nbsp;
  if (search) {
    query = query.where(
      or(
        ilike(threadsTable.title, `%${search}%`),
        ilike(threadsTable.body, `%${search}%`)
      )
    );
  }
&nbsp;
  const result = await query;
  return result[0]?.count || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >0;</span>
}
&nbsp;
export async function getThreadById(threadId: string) {
  const threads = await db
    .select()
    .from(threadsTable)
    .where(eq(threadsTable.threadId, threadId))
    .limit(1);
&nbsp;
  return threads[0] || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >null;</span>
}
&nbsp;
export async function createThread(threadData: {
  title: string;
  body: string;
  createdBy: string;
  subjectId?: string;
  topicId?: string;
}) {
  const newThreads = await db
    .insert(threadsTable)
    .values(threadData)
    .returning();
&nbsp;
  return newThreads[0];
}
&nbsp;
export async function deleteThread(threadId: string) {
  await db
    .delete(threadsTable)
    .where(eq(threadsTable.threadId, threadId));
}
&nbsp;
export async function updateThreadLikes(threadId: string, increment = <span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >true)</span> {
  const result = await db
    .update(threadsTable)
    .set({
      likeCount: increment
        ? sql`${threadsTable.likeCount} + 1`
        : sql`${threadsTable.likeCount} - 1`
    })
    .where(eq(threadsTable.threadId, threadId))
    .returning({ likeCount: threadsTable.likeCount });
&nbsp;
  return result[0]?.likeCount;
}
&nbsp;
// Comment Operations
export async function getCommentsByThreadId(threadId: string) {
  return await db
    .select()
    .from(commentsTable)
    .where(eq(commentsTable.threadId, threadId))
    .orderBy(asc(commentsTable.timestamp));
}
&nbsp;
export async function createComment(commentData: {
  threadId: string;
  senderId: string;
  content: string;
  parentCommentId?: string;
}) {
  const newComments = await db
    .insert(commentsTable)
    .values(commentData)

// Utility function to check if tables exist
export async function checkTablesExist() {
  try {
    // Execute a query to check if tables exist in the database
    const result = await db.execute(sql`
      SELECT table_name 
      FROM information_schema.tables 
      WHERE table_schema = 'public' 
      AND table_name IN ('users', 'threads', 'doubt_solving_sessions')
    `);
    
    // Create a set of existing table names for easy lookup
    const existingTables = new Set(result.rows.map(row =&gt; row.table_name));
    
    return {
      users: existingTables.has('users'),
      threads: existingTables.has('threads'),
      sessions: existingTables.has('doubt_solving_sessions'),
    };
  } catch (error) {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    console.error('Table check failed:', error);</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return {</span>
      users: false,
      threads: false,
      sessions: false,
    };
  }

import { sql } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { auth } from '@clerk/nextjs/server';
&nbsp;
export async function syncUserToDatabase(retries = 3): Promise&lt;{ success: boolean; message: string; userId?: string }&gt; {
  for (let attempt = 1; attempt &lt;= retries; attempt++) {
    try {
      // Get the current user from Clerk
      const { userId } = await auth();
&nbsp;
      if (!userId) {
        return { success: false, message: 'No user found to sync' };
      }
&nbsp;
      // Check if user already exists in database by clerkId
      const existingUserByClerkId = await db.execute(sql`
        SELECT "user_id" FROM users WHERE "clerk_id" = ${userId} LIMIT 1
      `);
&nbsp;
      if (existingUserByClerkId.rows &amp;&amp; existingUserByClerkId.rows.length &gt; 0) {
        // User exists with this clerkId, update their info
        const result = await db.execute(sql`
          UPDATE users SET 
            "last_active_at" = NOW()
          WHERE "clerk_id" = ${userId}
          RETURNING "user_id", "clerk_id", "full_name", email
        `);
&nbsp;
        const updatedUser = result.rows[0];
        console.log('User updated in database:', updatedUser);
&nbsp;
        return {
          success: true,
          message: 'User updated successfully',
          userId: updatedUser.user_id as string
        };
      }
&nbsp;
      // User doesn't exist, create new user with minimal required fields
      const result = await db.execute(sql`
        INSERT INTO users ("clerk_id", "full_name", email, role, "is_locked", "joined_at", "last_active_at")
        VALUES (
          ${userId},
          'User',
          '',
          'student',
          false,
          NOW(),
          NOW()
        )
        RETURNING "user_id", "clerk_id", "full_name", email
      `);
&nbsp;
      const newUser = result.rows[0];
      console.log('User synced to database:', newUser);
&nbsp;
      return {
        success: true,
        message: 'User created successfully',
        userId: newUser.user_id as string
      };
&nbsp;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`User sync attempt ${attempt} failed:`, error);
&nbsp;
      if (attempt === retries) {
        return {
          success: false,
          message: `Failed to sync user after ${retries} attempts: ${error}`
        };
      }
&nbsp;
      // Wait before retrying (exponential backoff)
      await new Promise(resolve =&gt; setTimeout(resolve, Math.pow(2, attempt) * 1000));
    }
  }
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  return { success: false, message: 'Unexpected error during user sync' };</span>
}
&nbsp;
export async function ensureUserExists(clerkId: string): Promise&lt;{ exists: boolean; userId?: string }&gt; {
  try {
    const existingUser = await db.execute(sql`
      SELECT "user_id" FROM users WHERE "clerk_id" = ${clerkId} LIMIT 1
    `);
&nbsp;
    if (existingUser.rows &amp;&amp; existingUser.rows.length &gt; 0) {
      return { exists: true, userId: existingUser.rows[0].user_id as string };
    }
&nbsp;
    return { exists: false };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error checking if user exists:', error);
    return { exists: false };
  }

/**
 * Downloads a file from a URL by fetching it as a blob and creating a download link
 * @param url - The URL of the file to download
 * @param filename - The desired filename for the download
 * @param fallbackUrl - Optional fallback URL to open in new tab if download fails
 */
export async function downloadFile(url: string, filename: string, fallbackUrl?: string): Promise&lt;void&gt; {
  try {
    console.log(`📥 Starting download: ${filename}`);
&nbsp;
    const response = await fetch(url);
    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`);
    }
&nbsp;
    const blob = await response.blob();
    const downloadUrl = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = downloadUrl;
    link.download = filename;
&nbsp;
    // Add the link to DOM temporarily
    document.body.appendChild(link);
&nbsp;
    // Trigger download
    link.click();
&nbsp;
    // Clean up
    document.body.removeChild(link);
    try {
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(downloadUrl);
    } catch (error) {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      console.warn('Could not revoke object URL:', error);</span>
    }
&nbsp;
    console.log(`✅ Download initiated: ${filename}`);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('❌ Download failed:', error);
&nbsp;
    // Show user-friendly error message
    const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >'Unknown error';</span>
    console.warn(`Download failed for ${filename}: ${errorMessage}. Opening in new tab instead.`);
&nbsp;
    // Fallback to opening in new tab
    if (fallbackUrl) {
      try {
        const fallbackResponse = await fetch(fallbackUrl);
        if (fallbackResponse.ok) {
          const fallbackBlob = await fallbackResponse.blob();
          const fallbackDownloadUrl = window.URL.createObjectURL(fallbackBlob);
          const fallbackLink = document.createElement('a');
          fallbackLink.href = fallbackDownloadUrl;
          fallbackLink.download = filename;
          document.body.appendChild(fallbackLink);
          fallbackLink.click();
          document.body.removeChild(fallbackLink);
          window.URL.revokeObjectURL(fallbackDownloadUrl);
        } else <span class="missing-if-branch" title="else path not taken" >E</span>{
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          window.open(fallbackUrl, '_blank');</span>
        }
      } catch (fallbackError) {
        window.open(fallbackUrl, '_blank');
      }
    } else {
      window.open(url, '_blank');
    }
  }
}

FILE: src/middleware.ts
================================================
import { clerkMiddleware } from '@clerk/nextjs/server';
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';

// Map of redirect paths
const redirectPaths: Record<string, string> = {
  '/ai-solver': '/tools/doubt-solving',
  '/flashcards': '/tools/flashcards',
  '/mind-maps': '/tools/mind-maps',
  '/progress': '/tools/progress-tracking'
};

// Define public routes - any routes not in this list will require authentication
const publicPaths = [
  "/",
  "/sign-in*",
  "/sign-up*",
  "/api*",
  "/custom-auth/sign-in*",
  "/custom-auth/sign-up*",
  "/custom-auth/reset-password*",
  "/sso-callback*",
];

export default clerkMiddleware((auth, req) => {
  const url = req.nextUrl;
  const path = url.pathname;

  // Handle redirects
  if (path in redirectPaths) {
    const redirectUrl = new URL(redirectPaths[path], req.url);
    redirectUrl.search = url.search;
    return NextResponse.redirect(redirectUrl);
  }

  return NextResponse.next();
});

export const config = {
  matcher: [
    // Skip Next.js internals and all static files, unless found in search params
    '/((?!_next|[^?]*\\.(?:html?|css|js(?!on)|jpe?g|webp|png|gif|svg|ttf|woff2?|ico|csv|docx?|xlsx?|zip|webmanifest)).*)',
    // Always run for API routes
    '/(api|trpc)(.*)',
  ],
};

// Suppress specific console warnings in tests
const originalConsoleError = console.error
console.error = (...args: any[]) => {
  if (
    typeof args[0] === 'string' &&
    (args[0].includes('Warning: ReactDOM.render is no longer supported') ||
     args[0].includes('Warning: An invalid form control') ||
     args[0].includes('React does not recognize the `whileHover` prop') ||
     args[0].includes('React does not recognize the `whileTap` prop') ||
     args[0].includes('React does not recognize the `animate` prop') ||
     args[0].includes('React does not recognize the `initial` prop') ||
     args[0].includes('React does not recognize the `exit` prop') ||
     args[0].includes('inside a test was not wrapped in act') ||
     // Expected error logs from unit tests simulating failure scenarios
     args[0].includes('Download failed') ||
     args[0].includes('Upload error') ||
     args[0].includes('Delete error') ||
     args[0].includes('Drizzle API Error') ||
     args[0].includes('Drizzle Create Thread Error') ||
     args[0].includes('User sync attempt') ||
     args[0].includes('Error checking if user exists') ||
     args[0].includes('Not implemented: window.open') ||
     args[0].includes('Error fetching') ||
     args[0].includes('AI request failed') ||
     args[0].includes('React does not recognize the `whileInView` prop'))
  ) {
    return
  }
  originalConsoleError.call(console, ...args)
}

// Suppress specific console warnings in tests (e.g., expected network/download fallbacks)
const originalConsoleWarn = console.warn
console.warn = (...args: any[]) => {
  if (
    typeof args[0] === 'string' &&
    (args[0].includes('Download failed for') ||
     args[0].includes('Could not revoke object URL'))
  ) {
    return
  }
  originalConsoleWarn.call(console, ...args)
}

// Setup fetch mock
require('jest-fetch-mock').enableMocks() 

// Polyfill missing browser APIs for JSDOM environment used by Jest
if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
  // Stub window.open to prevent JSDOM not-implemented errors (jsdom provides but throws)
  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/ban-ts-comment
  // @ts-ignore
  window.open = jest.fn();

  // Ensure URL API functions exist
  if (!('createObjectURL' in window.URL)) {
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/ban-ts-comment
    // @ts-ignore
    window.URL.createObjectURL = jest.fn(() => 'blob:http://localhost/mock');
  }
  if (!('revokeObjectURL' in window.URL)) {
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/ban-ts-comment
    // @ts-ignore
    window.URL.revokeObjectURL = jest.fn();
  }
}

// Test utilities for async operations

  new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 0))

  new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, delay))

// Mock API responses
export const mockApiResponse = (data: any, status = 200) => ({
  ok: status >= 200 && status < 300,
  status,
  json: () => Promise.resolve(data),
  text: () => Promise.resolve(JSON.stringify(data)),
})

export const mockApiError = (message = 'API Error', status = 500) => ({
  ok: false,
  status,
  json: () => Promise.resolve({ error: message }),
  text: () => Promise.resolve(JSON.stringify({ error: message })),
})

// User interaction helpers
export const simulateTyping = async (element: HTMLElement, text: string, delay = 10) => {
  const { userEvent } = await import('@testing-library/user-event')
  const user = userEvent.setup({ delay })
  await user.clear(element)
  await user.type(element, text)
}

export const simulateFileUpload = async (input: HTMLInputElement, file: File) => {
  const { userEvent } = await import('@testing-library/user-event')
  const user = userEvent.setup()
  await user.upload(input, file)
}

// Network request mocking
export const mockFetch = (responses: Array<{ url: string; response: any; status?: number }>) => {
  global.fetch = jest.fn((url: string) => {
    const mockResponse = responses.find(r => url.includes(r.url))
    if (mockResponse) {
      return Promise.resolve(mockApiResponse(mockResponse.response, mockResponse.status))
    }
    return Promise.reject(new Error(`No mock response for ${url}`))
  }) as jest.Mock
}

export const resetFetchMocks = () => {
  if (jest.isMockFunction(global.fetch)) {
    (global.fetch as jest.Mock).mockClear()
  }
}

// Time testing utilities
export const mockDateNow = (timestamp: number) => {
  const spy = jest.spyOn(Date, 'now')
  spy.mockReturnValue(timestamp)
  return spy
}

export const restoreDateNow = (spy: jest.SpyInstance) => {
  spy.mockRestore()
}

"use client";

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import Navbar from "@/components/landingpage/layout/Navbar";
import Footer from "@/components/landingpage/section/Footer";
import AuthCheck from "@/components/auth/AuthCheck";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";

export default function PagesLayout({
  children,
}: Readonly<{
  children: React.ReactNode;
}>) {
  const [isScrolled, setIsScrolled] = useState(false);
  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = useState(false);
  const pathname = usePathname();

  // Check if the current path is the doubt-solving page
  const isDoubtSolvingPage = pathname?.includes('/tools/doubt-solving');

  // Check if the current path is the community page
  const isCommunityPage = pathname?.includes('/community');

  // Check if the current path is a profile page
  const isProfilePage = pathname?.includes('/profile/');

  // Check if the current path is the chat page
  const isChatPage = pathname?.includes('/chat');

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleScroll = () => {
      setIsScrolled(window.scrollY > 50);
    };

    const handleResize = () => {
      setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < 768);
    };

    window.addEventListener("scroll", handleScroll);
    window.addEventListener("resize", handleResize);
    handleResize(); // Set initial value

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("scroll", handleScroll);
      window.removeEventListener("resize", handleResize);
    };
  }, []);

  // For the doubt-solving page, just render the children without the layout
  if (isDoubtSolvingPage) {
    return <AuthCheck>{children}</AuthCheck>;
  }

  // For the community page and profile pages, render without navbar (they have their own)
  if (isCommunityPage || isProfilePage || isChatPage) {
    return (
      <AuthCheck>
        <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-gray-50 to-indigo-50 dark:from-gray-900 dark:to-indigo-950 transition-colors duration-300">
          <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-[radial-gradient(#e5e7eb_1px,transparent_1px)] dark:bg-[radial-gradient(#2a2a3a_1px,transparent_1px)] [background-size:40px_40px] [mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse_50%_50%_at_50%_50%,#000_70%,transparent_100%)]"></div>
          <main className="relative">
            <div className="w-full">
              {children}
            </div>
          </main>
        </div>
      </AuthCheck>
    );
  }

  // For other pages, use the normal layout
  return (
    <AuthCheck>
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-gray-50 to-indigo-50 dark:from-gray-900 dark:to-indigo-950 transition-colors duration-300">
        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-[radial-gradient(#e5e7eb_1px,transparent_1px)] dark:bg-[radial-gradient(#2a2a3a_1px,transparent_1px)] [background-size:40px_40px] [mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse_50%_50%_at_50%_50%,#000_70%,transparent_100%)]"></div>
        <Navbar isScrolled={isScrolled} />
        <main className="relative pt-24 pb-16">
          {isCommunityPage ? (
            // Full width for community page
            <div className="w-full">
              {children}
            </div>
          ) : (
            // Constrained width for other pages
            <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
              {children}
            </div>
          )}
        </main>
        <Footer />
      </div>
    </AuthCheck>
  );
}

    },
  ];

  const filteredPosts = blogPosts.filter((post) => {
    const matchesCategory = activeCategory === "All" || post.category === activeCategory;
    const matchesSearch = post.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
      post.excerpt.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());
    return matchesCategory && matchesSearch;
  });

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title="Manetho Blog"
        description="Insights, tips, and resources to enhance your learning journey"
      />

      <div className="mb-12">
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center gap-6 mb-8">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            {categories.map((category) => (
              <button
                key={category}
                onClick={() => setActiveCategory(category)}
                className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-sm font-medium transition-colors ${activeCategory === category
                    ? "bg-cyan-100 text-cyan-800 dark:bg-cyan-900 dark:text-cyan-100"
                    : "bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-gray-700"
                  }`}
              >
                {category}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          <div className="relative w-full md:w-72">
            <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 flex items-center pl-3 pointer-events-none">
              <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400" />
            </div>
            <input
              type="search"
              className="pl-10 pr-4 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg w-full focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-cyan-600 text-sm dark:text-gray-300 dark:placeholder-gray-500"
              placeholder="Search articles..."
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8">
          {filteredPosts.length > 0 ? (
            filteredPosts.map((post) => (
              <article
                key={post.id}
                className="bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-md hover:shadow-lg transition-shadow duration-300"
              >
                <div className="h-48 overflow-hidden">
                  <img
                    src={post.image}
                    alt={post.title}
                    className="w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-500 hover:scale-105"
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="p-6">
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-4">
                    <span className="text-xs font-medium px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-cyan-100 text-cyan-800 dark:bg-cyan-900 dark:text-cyan-100">
                      {post.category}
                    </span>
                    <div className="flex items-center text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 text-sm">
                      <Clock className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />
                      {post.readTime}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white mb-3">
                    {post.title}
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300 mb-4">
                    {post.excerpt}
                  </p>
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-center mt-6">
                    <div className="flex items-center text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
                      <User className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />
                      {post.author}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                      {post.date}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <Button
                    variant="link"
                    className="px-0 mt-4 text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-400 hover:text-cyan-700 dark:hover:text-cyan-300"
                  >
                    Read More <span className="ml-1">→</span>
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </article>
            ))
          ) : (
            <div className="col-span-full text-center py-12">
              <BookOpen className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto text-gray-400 dark:text-gray-600 mb-4" />
              <h3 className="text-xl font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-white mb-2">
                No articles found
              </h3>
              <p className="text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
                Try adjusting your search or filter to find what you're looking for
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-100 to-blue-100 dark:from-cyan-900/30 dark:to-blue-900/30 rounded-xl p-8 text-center mb-8">
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white mb-4">
          Subscribe to Our Newsletter
        </h2>
        <p className="text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-6 max-w-2xl mx-auto">
          Get the latest educational insights, study tips, and updates delivered straight to your inbox.
        </p>
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2 max-w-md mx-auto">
          <input
            type="email"
            placeholder="Your email address"
            className="flex-grow px-4 py-2 rounded-lg border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-700 bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-cyan-600"
          />
          <Button className="whitespace-nowrap">
            Subscribe
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
